title: Bubble Fox Friends Meet in Niseko
content: A bright anime-style fantasy travel scene in front of Niseko View Plaza in Hokkaido, with a clear blue sky, scattered white clouds, and a huge snow-capped mountain rising in the background. The setting is a roadside plaza parking area with a modern black-and-wood station building on the left, visible Japanese signage reading "道の駅 ニセコビュープラザ" and "Niseko View Plaza," a vertical banner reading "ようこそ ニセコへ," a tall food sign reading "名物 じゃがいも," and a dark wayfinding sign on the right reading "ニセコ Niseko" with 4 listed icons and labels: "名産品 Local Products," "農産物直売所 Farmer's Market," "レストラン Restaurant," and "情報コーナー Information." In the center, a glamorous fox-eared anime girl sits sideways atop a giant iridescent translucent soap bubble, smiling and gesturing upward with one hand. She has {{hair_color}} very long wavy hair, large fluffy fox ears, and a huge fluffy fox tail with rainbow-reflective highlights. Her outfit is an elaborate sparkling translucent-white and pale blue dress with holographic sheen, layered sleeves, gemstone accents, ribbons, and glossy lace-up ankle boots with bows, giving her a magical bubble-fox idol appearance. Around her float multiple smaller soap bubbles, catching rainbow light. Three fox-girl friends gather around meeting her at the plaza: 1 dark-haired fox-eared girl in a navy jacket with a Niseko patch, holding a vanilla soft-serve ice cream and looking toward the center; 1 khaki-clad fox-eared girl in an outdoor jacket and a dark cap with "HOTEL" lettering, holding a grilled corn cob; and 1 white-haired fox-eared girl in a shiny pearly hooded jacket and beret, holding a takeaway coffee cup and wearing a black backpack. Emphasize a cheerful reunion mood, travel photography composition blended with polished anime illustration, detailed environmental signage, reflective bubble surfaces, soft sunlight, crisp mountain air, and high-detail painterly rendering.

title: Surreal Clockwork Gentleman on a Gear
content: A surreal impasto oil painting in the spirit of a late-19th-century post-impressionist masterpiece, showing a stout gentleman in a patterned golden-blue suit and tall top hat balancing awkwardly on a giant bronze gear high above a sunlit canal city. His face is obscured by a centered vertical rectangular censor block in warm brown, creating an intentional anonymous focal interruption. He wears a richly textured jacket with mosaic-like patches of ochre, cobalt, rust, and cream, matching trousers, heavy leather boots, and a waist area that opens into an exposed clockwork mechanism full of gears and ornate brass details. His body leans forward with both hands extended as if trying to keep balance, one boot planted on the gear and the other lifted slightly outward. The background is an airy blue sky with swirling painterly clouds and scattered gold brushstrokes, while below and to the left appears a historic bell tower and arched waterfront architecture, and to the right distant terracotta rooftops beside shimmering water. Use thick visible brushstrokes, luminous warm highlights, bold blue-and-gold contrast, expressive texture, and a whimsical steampunk-meets-Venetian atmosphere. Compose the figure large and central, slightly cropped by the frame, with the giant gear visible beneath him and the city receding below.

title: Steampunk Cat Airship Over the Sea
content: A whimsical fantasy oil painting of a gigantic flying steamship shaped like a cat, drifting above a bright ocean under a clear blue sky filled with soft pink clouds. The vessel dominates the composition in a low-angle three-quarter view from the front-left, making it feel monumental and airborne. Its hull is rounded and bulbous like a zeppelin-ship hybrid, painted pastel pink and lavender with warm peach highlights, and the bow is sculpted into the face of a fluffy cat with pale pink fur, pointed ears, luminous blue eyes, a small nose, and a huge open mouth lined with sharp dark teeth like a bizarre figurehead-jaw entrance. Ornate gilded brass trim, filigree, railings, pipes, rivets, balconies, portholes, hanging ornaments, and decorative mechanical fittings cover the ship. There are 4 tall smokestacks rising from the top deck, each striped in warm copper, red, and gold, releasing thick cotton-candy pink smoke that curls painterly into the sky. The upper deck is crowded with intricate Victorian steampunk details, domes, spires, lamp-like finials, tiny structures, and a small golden cat statue near the front. A suspended gondola or platform hangs beneath the belly of the ship with tiny visible machinery and a reddish-orange base. In the distance, 3 smaller ships appear near the horizon over choppy teal water, reinforcing the scale. The sea below is painted with lively waves and white foam. Use an imaginative storybook steampunk aesthetic with rich impasto brushstrokes, visible painterly texture, glowing sunlight, romantic pastel colors, and a dreamlike mood reminiscent of a fantastical maritime voyage. Vertical composition, highly detailed, magical, surreal, elegant, and playful.

title: Dark Creative Overload at Night
content: A moody cinematic digital illustration of a tired young creator sitting alone at a cluttered desk in a dark room at night, seen in three-quarter side view, leaning forward with one elbow on the desk and one hand covering part of the face in an exhausted, overwhelmed pose. The face is intentionally obscured in shadow. The person wears dark casual clothes and a lanyard badge, suggesting a student, designer, or medical worker. The room feels realistic and slightly messy, with a desk lamp, papers, sketchbooks, mugs, stationery, and stacked books. On the left wall, include 2 illuminated X-ray films and a round wall clock, plus shelves and pinned notes in deep shadow. In front of the person is a glowing widescreen monitor showing an AI image generation or creative editing interface with a city-at-sunset artwork in the main preview and a row of thumbnail variations beneath it, modern dark UI, one purple action button. The monitor is the main light source, casting warm orange and cool blue highlights across the desk. Around the monitor and pouring out into the air, depict a vast surreal explosion of imagination and digital creativity: a swirling galaxy-like vortex with stars, nebula colors, spark particles, light trails, and cosmic dust in purple, blue, pink, and gold. Embed many floating dreamlike elements inside the swirl: a fantasy castle on a floating island with a tree, planets and moons, an astronaut, a film clapperboard, a video camera, musical notes, glowing silhouettes of people, a futuristic city skyline, a hot-air balloon, a car, birds, jellyfish-like luminous creatures, and multiple cats, including 1 giant sleeping orange tabby cat in the upper right and 1 cat in a space helmet near the lower right. The magical imagery should feel like thoughts escaping from the computer, beautiful but slightly dark and overwhelming, as if creativity, obsession, and emotional intensity are filling the room. Include a skeletal anatomy hand model standing beside the monitor on the right side of the desk, reinforcing an art-studio or study setting. Use dramatic low-key lighting, high contrast, intricate detail, volumetric glow, cinematic depth, and a balance of realism and fantastical surrealism. The overall mood is melancholic, imaginative, and darkly inspiring, visualizing the feeling of being consumed by ideas generated through {{creative_tool}}.

The style is a realistic mixed-media travel diary with watercolor map art, handwritten Chinese titles, taped instant photos, doodles, and soft natural light. On the upper left page, write the date "2024.09.20." in small handwriting and a large black brush-style Chinese title reading {{title_text}}. Arrange 5 Polaroid-style instant photos across the spread, each slightly tilted and attached with beige or patterned washi tape: 1 photo at upper left showing two travelers by a blue alpine lake labeled "天山天池"; 1 tall photo near upper center-left showing three people on a green grassland labeled "那拉提草原"; 1 photo at lower left showing a couple by a deep blue lake labeled "赛里木湖"; 1 photo at upper center-right showing two travelers on a long empty road under a bright blue sky labeled "沙漠公路"; 1 photo at lower center showing two figures standing on dunes at sunset labeled "日落沙丘". Add small handwritten bilingual place annotations near the left-page photos: "天山天池 (Tianshan Tianchi)", "赛拉木草原 (Sayram Lake)", "沙漠公路 (Desert Highway)", and "日落沙丘 (Sunset Dunes)" in a casual notebook style. On the right page, paint a loose watercolor map of Xinjiang in beige, pale green, and blue, with a bold winding blue road route crossing the region and exactly 10 red location pins placed along the route. Include map doodles: a small mountain icon cluster near the top, a river and several blue lakes, a tiny compass in the upper right, 2 camel drawings, 2 yurt drawings, and thin gray roads branching around the main blue route. Along the bottom of the right page, place 3 more taped Polaroid photos: 1 at lower left showing people in colorful ethnic clothing labeled "大巴扎"; 1 at lower middle showing hands holding grilled meat skewers labeled "烤肉串"; 1 at lower right showing a couple inside a yurt labeled "蒙古包自拍". Scatter small hand-drawn doodles throughout both pages, including a sun, a tiny car, 2 horse drawings, 4 fish icons, a crescent moon, several stars, small arrows, flames near the food photo and along the lower map area, and tiny decorative swirls. Keep all text in Chinese where shown, with a lively hand-journal aesthetic, realistic paper texture, slight shadows under every photo, and an overall cozy memory-book feeling of a Xinjiang road trip.

title: 虚构“裙装对决”漫画跨页
content: A photorealistic overhead view of an open Japanese manga magazine held in two human hands at the lower left and lower right corners, shown as a dramatic two-page black-and-white comic spread on slightly warm paper with visible page curvature, center gutter distortion, ink texture, screentone shading, and dense speed lines. The magazine fills almost the entire frame on a neutral tabletop. The spread depicts a fictional over-the-top battle sports manga about {{sport_name}}, with exaggerated action, intense expressions, and absurdly serious tournament storytelling. In the center across both pages, show 2 main full-body schoolgirl fighters in a chaotic combat scene: on the left page center a long-haired teenage girl in a dark school blazer, ribbon tie, pleated skirt, and loafers spins powerfully with both arms raised overhead, her hair and skirt flaring in a circular arc; on the right page center a second teenage girl in a sailor-style school uniform is upside down in a handstand-like impact pose, one leg thrust high into the air, skirt exploding outward with violent motion lines, as if she has been thrown or is counterattacking. Make the composition packed with explosive radial lines, debris-like ink flecks, dramatic foreshortening, and giant bold Japanese sound-effect typography crossing the gutter. The spread should read like a mainstream shonen battle manga but focused on skirts and rotational motion rather than weapons. Include exactly 8 side panels around the central action: 4 stacked along the far left page and 4 along the far right page. On the left side, panel 1 shows a girl standing under a waterfall in ascetic training, panel 2 shows inverted handstand practice in shallow water, panel 3 shows intense physical training on the ground, panel 4 shows 2 girls in a close emotional conversation. On the right side, panel 1 shows a composed rival girl in portrait close-up, panel 2 shows a roaring audience in stadium stands, panel 3 shows a small comedic rules diagram explaining the sport with 2 simplified girls and a skirt icon, panel 4 shows a shocked face close-up reaction. Render all text as authentic Japanese manga lettering and captions, including vertical title calligraphy, side narration boxes, crowd chants, rule panel labels, and large impact kanji; use the visible phrases as inspiration but do not prioritize perfect legibility. Add one oversized vertical title on the left page reading {{attack_name_left}} and one huge central impact phrase on the right page reading {{attack_name_right}}. Preserve the feeling of a fake magazine feature or serialized manga chapter discovered in print, with believable halftone dots, slightly worn page edges, high contrast black ink, and a humorous yet sincerely epic tone.

title: Luxury Concept Poster Design

巨大な文字「{{人物名}}」を画面全体の主役として配置してください。文字は太く、力強く、圧倒的な存在感を持つサンセリフ体。背景は{{背景色}}、文字は少し黄味がかったオフホワイトで、ヴィンテージのシルクスクリーン印刷や古いポスターのような紙質感、粒子感、軽い擦れを加えてください。

全体は極簡で力強いグラフィックポスターにしてください。要素を増やしすぎず、文字、人物、ロケット、赤い噴煙だけで構成します。構図は大胆で、遠くから見ても一目で印象に残るデザインにしてください。

左下に小さく「VISION / SCALE / MOTION」、右下に「BUILD THE FUTURE.」のような短い補助テキストを入れてください。必要に応じてTeslaやXを連想させる小さな記号を控えめに配置してもよいですが、主役はあくまで「ELON MUSK」という文字と人物の象徴性です。

title: Dance Choreography Instruction Sheet
content:
Dance Sequence Instruction Sheet
[VISUAL STYLE]
A composition featuring a highly detailed 3D-rendered female dancer. Designed like a professional choreography guide with a technical, diagram-inspired layout. Clean white background, soft studio lighting, and strong contrast to highlight body movement and posture.
[GRID LAYOUT]
Structured 4×4 panel grid (16 frames total), evenly spaced with thin black divider lines. Each panel is identical in size and clearly numbered from 1 to 16 to show a continuous dance progression.
[CHARACTER]
Use {{reference}} as the base character. The same female dancer appears consistently across all panels with accurate likeness and proportions.
[WARDROBE]
The dancer wears a stylish, performance-ready outfit: a {{clothing}}. The look should feel modern and visually appealing while still practical for dance movement. Fabric should subtly respond to motion (slight flow and folds), even in grayscale.
[PANEL STRUCTURE – EACH FRAME]
Top-left: Step number + short dance move title (e.g., “Step 5 – Spin Transition”)
Center: Full-body pose capturing a precise moment in the choreography
Bottom-left: 3–4 lines of concise instruction describing the move
Overlay: Motion arrows and directional guides illustrating how the dancer transitions
[MOTION INDICATORS]
Incorporate curved arrows for fluid motion, straight arrows for directional steps, and circular indicators for spins or turns. Emphasize rhythm, weight shifts, and body isolation.
[RENDER QUALITY]
High-detail sculpted 3D style with smooth grayscale shading, subtle shadows, and clean linework. Maintain a polished, concept-art level finish with clarity in every pose.
[RESTRICTIONS]
No color, no background scenery, no extra characters, no visual clutter, only the dancer and instructional elements..

title: Anime Museum Poster with Kannon Statue
content: A polished Japanese museum exhibition poster in a contemporary anime illustration style, vertical layout, warm ivory and gold color palette with pastel confetti accents, designed like a high-end promotional ad for a spring holiday event. The composition features 4 school-age to young adult female characters in the foreground and one monumental Buddhist statue in the background. At center back is a towering gilded Thousand-Armed Kannon statue with a radiant halo, intricate carved details, many arms fanning outward symmetrically, and hands pressed together in prayer at the chest, glowing with sacred golden light. In the foreground on the right is the largest figure, a friendly young woman guide or older student reaching one hand dramatically toward the viewer in forced perspective; she has {{hair_color}} shoulder-length hair, a blue striped blouse, a cream sweater draped over her shoulders, and a light skirt, with a warm inviting expression. Across the lower middle are 3 younger schoolgirls in matching uniforms: short-sleeve pale blue shirts with navy ribbon ties and dark blue skirts. Above it, add smaller text: "千手観音、祈りの宇宙". Add a red circular callout near the top left that says "はじめての美術館にもおすすめ!" and a white cloud-shaped speech bubble near the top right that says "いっしょに新しい発見をしよう!". Add a gold ribbon banner under the main headline reading "アスキー美術館 GW開催". Along the bottom center, add the museum name in large text: {{museum_name}}, followed by a smaller address line and nearest-station access text in Japanese. Add a red-and-black slogan along the bottom right: "心に残る体験が、きっとここに。". In the lower right, include 3 circular benefit icons with captions: one peach circle with a ticket icon and text "学生はお得! 学生証提示で当日券200円OFF!", one blue circle with a camera icon and text "撮影OK! 一部の作品は写真撮影OK!", and one gold circle with a gift icon and text "来場者プレゼント! オリジナルしおりをプレゼント!". title: 法国新浪潮抗议电影海报
content: 创作一张复古的法国新浪潮政治电影海报，采用撕纸拼贴风格，垂直单页构图，呈现出如同 1968 年贴在墙上饱经风霜的街头海报般的陈旧感。使用奶油色纸张、褪色的黑色、深红色、芥末黄和柔和的钴蓝色作为有限配色，并添加浓重的模拟胶片颗粒感、半色调印刷纹理、墨水渗漏、折痕、划痕、粗糙的纸张纤维、撕裂的边缘、胶水渍以及略有错位的凸版印刷字体。在中心位置放置一张黑白肖像，画面为一名穿着深色外套、神情忧郁的年轻男子，四分之三侧面，胸部以上剪裁，留着卷曲的深色头发，脸部被一块矩形纸片遮挡，如同审查标记，赋予画面神秘的艺术电影感。在肖像周围环绕撕裂的拼贴碎片：左上方是一个红色纸板，上面有奔跑抗议者的黑色剪影；下方是一条窄窄的灰白色文字条，写着“PARIS, MAI 68”以及较小的法文文案“LES MURS ONT DES OREILLES, L’AVENIR AUSSI.”；最左侧边缘是一条垂直的黑色胶片边框，印有白色的“36 KODAK TRI-X PAN FILM”；左下方是一个芥末黄色的撕裂纸板，上面有裁剪过的深色剪影肖像；右上方是一个蓝色撕裂纸板，包含引语“UN FILM COUP DE POING ET DE POÉSIE.”，下方注明“— CAHIERS DU CINÉMA”；其正下方是一张高大的黑白照片碎片，描绘了一个孤独的身影在夜晚的路灯下走过潮湿的巴黎街道；中右侧附近是一个小的撕裂新闻纸块，上面印有法文口号“LA BEAUTÉ EST DANS LA RUE”，背景是人群场景；右下方是一个红色撕裂纸板，上面有巴黎地标建筑的黑色剪影。在顶部正中，用窄体黑色大写字母添加标语“NOT EVERY REVOLUTION IS TELEVISED.”。在下方中部附近，用小号黑色压缩字体添加“A FILM BY {{director_name}}”。让主标题以巨大的红色压缩大写字母占据下半部分，覆盖在撕裂的奶油色纸张上：“{{French_title}}”。正下方用较小的蓝色压缩大写字母添加英文副标题“{{English_subtitle}}”。在底部中心放置一条黑色长条，上面印有白色大号压缩大写字母“COMING SOON”，下方是较小的文字“ÉTÉ 1968”。在左下角包含一个戛纳风格的月桂叶标志，写着“SÉLECTION OFFICIELLE FESTIVAL DE CANNES 1968”。在右下角添加细小的法文制作人员名单，包括“UNE PRODUCTION LES FILMS DU SOLEIL DISTRIBUTION”。保持整体设计的不对称性、原始感、叛逆感与优雅感，唤起人们对戈达尔、特吕弗、1968 年 5 月抗议图形以及手工制作的法国艺术电影海报拼贴的记忆。

title: 法国新浪潮风格撕纸拼贴海报
content: 一张 20 世纪 60 年代法国新浪潮电影海报拼贴画，背景为陈旧的米色纸张，设计风格模仿撕纸艺术电影海报，具有模拟颗粒感、做旧印刷纹理、粗糙的撕裂边缘、油墨磨损、半色调瑕疵以及轻微的套印不准。构图中心为一名留着凌乱深色头发的女子的黑白半身肖像，她抬手遮脸并拿着一支香烟，胸部以上构图，面部被一个矩形模糊块遮挡。采用分层拼贴布局，包含 8 个主要纸张元素：1) 左上角黑色文本块，上方写有“LES FILMS DU CARREFOUR présentent”，下方为堆叠的大字“ANNA KARINA”及较小的文本“dans un film de JEAN-LUC GODARD”；2) 左侧红色撕裂引用面板，写有“Il faut essayer d’être jeune comme on peut. - GODARD”；3) 右上角蓝色撕裂面板，带有黑色标签“PRIX JEAN VIGO 1962”；4) 右上角狭长的撕裂报纸剪报，写有“l’amour est plus fort que la mort”；5) 中右侧黄色撕裂面板，展示一名戴帽男子面对一名女子的黑色剪影，旁边是带有白色链轮孔的垂直黑色胶片边框；6) 左下角黑白巴黎街景照片，包含潮湿的地面、路灯、行人和清晰可见的“HOTEL DU NORD”标志；7) 左下角小型评论文本块，写有 '"LE FILM QUI A CHANGÉ LE CINÉMA" - CAHIERS DU CINÉMA'；8) 右下角裁剪过的黑白男子西装肖像，面部被矩形模糊块遮挡，部分被红色撕裂纸张形状覆盖。在下部中间，放置巨大的撕纸风格标题，使用粗体压缩大写字母：黑色“À BOUT DE”和红色“SOUFFLE”，略微倾斜并横跨大部分宽度。在标题下方，添加一条蓝色撕裂纸条，上面印有白色大写文本“UNE HISTOIRE D’AMOUR ET DE LIBERTÉ”。在底部中心，添加黑色大写字母“COMING SOON”，下方为“LES FILMS DU CARREFOUR”。调色板限制在褪色的奶油色、黑色、深群青色、柔和的海报红和芥末黄。整体氛围叛逆、浪漫且具有电影感，如同由撕碎的杂志、街头摄影和醒目排版构成的标志性法国新浪潮海报。

title: 桌面布置审计信息图
content: 使用 REFERENCE_0，将附带的桌面照片及其文字说明转化为一张简洁的编辑风格信息图海报。创建一个包含 2 个标注照片面板的左右对比图：左侧为“当前布置”，使用原始场景；右侧为“优化布置”，以匹配的角度展示同一房间和桌面的理想改进版本。在顶部添加一个醒目的大号衬线字体标题，内容为 {{headline_text}}。在左侧面板周围，添加 5 个由引导线连接的问题标注卡：1) 显示器高度 — 👍 可接受 — “屏幕距离尚可，但视线焦点分散” — 标签“颈部疲劳”；2) 座椅位置 — ❌ 严重影响 — “低矮休闲椅，支撑不足” — 标签“背痛 + 驼背”；3) 照明 — ⚠️ 损耗精力 — “混合光源 + 侧面眩光” — 标签“视疲劳”；4) 线缆管理 — ❌ 严重影响 — “桌面及地面线缆杂乱” — 标签“视觉干扰 / 绊倒风险”；5) 杂物 — ⚠️ 损耗精力 — “工具、盒子、纸张堆积” — 标签“注意力分散”。在座椅位置问题处添加一个红色的“首要修复”徽章。在右侧面板周围，添加 5 个改进后的标注卡：1) 显示器高度 — ✅ 良好 — “主屏幕居中，与视线齐平”；2) 座椅位置 — ✅ 良好 — “座椅推入，双脚平放，肘部约 90°”；3) 照明 — ✅ 良好 — “柔和前置光，眩光减少”；4) 线缆管理 — ✅ 良好 — “线缆收纳于桌下”；5) 杂物 — ✅ 良好 — “工作区整洁，设备分区明确”。在优化后的面板中，直观展示改进效果：主显示器居中，笔记本电脑置于下方，配备人体工学办公椅，桌面更整洁，线缆隐藏于桌下，光线柔和平衡，右侧增加一个小抽屉柜，同时保持房间原貌。在底部添加包含 5 个项目的图例：“图例”、“首要修复”、“良好”、“可接受”、“损耗精力”、“严重影响”。在最下方添加 4 个方框区域：1) “免费修复”包含 3 项： “首要修复：调整坐姿 / 告别低矮瘫坐”、“居中摆放主显示器”、“清理桌面及地面杂物”；2) “50 美元以下”包含 3 项： “魔术贴扎带 + 桌下理线槽”、“腰靠或脚垫”、“简约桌面收纳盒”；3) “值得投资”包含 3 项： “人体工学办公椅”、“显示器支架以实现完美对齐”、“封闭式储物柜 / 抽屉”；4) “专注力预测”显示 2 个仪表盘，分别标注为“当前：2.5 小时/天”和“完成前 3 项修复后：5.5 小时/天”，并配有一个绿色胶囊标签显示“+3.0 小时”。采用精致的杂志信息图美学，使用柔和的绿色与奶油色调，搭配圆角边框、极简文字、清晰图标、细连接线，以及适合社交媒体分享的精美排版。

title: 赛博朋克游戏联动海报
content: A cinematic crossover promotional poster for a gritty sci-fi military game collaboration, designed like a premium Chinese game event key visual. Vertical composition, ultra-detailed, dark futuristic battlefield city at night with rain, smoke, sparks, neon haze, satellite dishes, towers, launch structures, and a war-torn industrial skyline. Two female combat characters stand back-to-back in the center as the main focus. The left character is a tactical recon operative in a black hooded armored stealth suit with layered plates, straps, gauntlets, and glowing blue tech accents, holding a compact high-tech crossbow pointed downward; her silhouette is sleek, lethal, and military. The right character is a cyberpunk female fighter inspired by a punk marksman archetype, with long electric-{{hair_color}} braided hair, shaved side details, tattoos on her arm, black leather and tactical belts, and a large futuristic minigun-like weapon glowing purple-blue; she feels rebellious, dangerous, and iconic. Their faces are obscured by dark censor-like square blocks, preserving a mysterious meme-poster look. At the very top, small Chinese tagline text reads “两大战场 一种信念”. Dominating the header is enormous distressed metallic Chinese title text reading “三角洲行动 × 英雄联盟”, with the first part in weathered silver and the second part in worn gold. Beneath the headline is a thin line of smaller Chinese slogan text: “战术协同 · 信息制胜 · 突破极限”. On the left midground, include a large luminous blue holographic sign with a geometric logo and the word “HAAVK”. On the right midground, add a purple neon billboard with Chinese text “金克斯·信息位” and smaller subtitle lines beneath it. On the lower left near the left character, add a green-labeled caption box reading “露娜·侦察位”. Across the environment, add red laser streaks in the sky, blue scanning lines, purple atmospheric glow, faint explosions, and dense cinematic volumetric lighting. At the bottom center, place collaboration branding logos and text: “三角洲行动 × 英雄联盟” with English subtitles “DELTA FORCE” and “LEAGUE OF LEGENDS”, followed by the date line “战场集结 6月12日 战场重构”. Beneath that, show exactly 4 small feature badges in a row with icons and bilingual labels: “限定皮肤 / LIMITED SKIN”, “限定任务 / LIMITED MISSIONS”, “专属奖励 / EXCLUSIVE REWARDS”, and “战术协同 / TACTICAL SYNERGY”. Add a final small Chinese footer slogan and tiny copyright text. Overall style: blockbuster game marketing art, hyper-detailed photorealistic concept art, cyberpunk militarism, Tencent-style collaboration poster, dramatic contrast, blue-purple-orange lighting, crisp typography, epic and commercially polished.

content: 一张写实的竖版智能手机照片，拍摄了一位 {{person}} 站在厨房或餐桌旁，在白色塑料切菜板上切熟桃子的场景。主体位于画面中心，取景范围约为大腿中部或腰部以上，身体微微向镜头倾斜，呈现出随意的抓拍姿态。她留着非常浓密、长且深棕至黑色的天然卷发，发丝卷曲分明并带有少量浅棕色挑染，垂在肩头并部分遮住脸颊两侧。她穿着一件超大号的 {{hoodie_color}} 连帽衫，袖口宽松，赋予画面一种轻松的居家生活感。一只手垂直握着厨房刀，正在切开位于切菜板中央的桃瓣，另一只手扶着水果。切菜板上清晰可见 7 块桃子：左侧有 3 块较小的桃瓣，中间有 1 块正在切开的桃瓣，右侧有 3 块较大的桃子（包括半个桃子）。桌面为浅色木纹。房间光线温暖舒适，背景为米色墙壁和天花板，左上方可见一台带有 3 片扇叶的深色吊扇，左侧墙上挂有 2 幅植物画框，左下角背景处有一盆绿叶植物，桌后有一把浅鼠尾草绿色的椅子，右侧悬挂着一个发光的白色圆纸灯笼，右后方背景处有一块彩虹色调的墙面挂饰或反光织物面板。采用柔和的室内光线、自然的肤色、细腻的阴影、写实的水果纹理和刀具细节、纪录片风格的构图、浅至中等的景深，营造出真实地道的日常居家美学。

title: 奢华香水蜕变艺术
content:
一件高端电影感蜕变艺术作品，以五个垂直面板呈现，展示 {{subject}} 从原始精华演变为雕塑杰作的过程，每个面板由细黑线分隔。
面板 1（起源）：一个高级玻璃香水瓶静置于深色反光表面上，周围环绕着 {{ingredients}}，柔和的摄影棚灯光，优雅的阴影。
面板 2（释放）：香水开始向空气中扩散，可见的香氛雾气呈流体状向上盘旋，形成柔和的有机形状，伴有发光粒子和蒸汽轨迹。
面板 3（蜕变）：雾气开始塑造成半成形的轮廓（抽象的人形或飘逸的织物），融合了液体、蒸汽与光影，梦幻而明亮。
面板 4（抽象）：形态变得完全抽象——流动的香氛丝带转化为光滑的玻璃状曲线和流体几何结构，动态瞬间定格于空中。
面板 5（升华）：最终形态——一个奢华的雕塑感香水瓶或受香氛精华启发的抽象玻璃雕像，经过抛光，具有反光效果，带有发光高光，置于极简底座之上。
风格：超精细，从写实到抽象的演变，深黑色背景，{{accents}}，柔和光晕，高对比度照明，光泽反射，电影级奢华美学，香水广告风格，4K 画质，焦点清晰。

Around the staff, 2 sweeping metallic-gold brushstroke ribbons spiral upward in elegant S-curves, like calligraphic energy trails, partially transparent and painterly. Keep the composition spacious with strong negative space and a premium gallery-poster feel. Add 5 text groups arranged in traditional poster layout: on the upper left, a large vertical black calligraphy headline reading {{headline_text}}; beside it, a smaller vertical line of Chinese text reading "心有如意，万象皆可破"; below that, a small romanized subtitle in thin uppercase serif/sans style reading "RUYI JINGUBANG"; on the lower right, another vertical poetic line reading "一念起，风云动 / 一棒定，乾坤静"; at the bottom center, a faint small horizontal line reading "自在如意，无所不成". Include 2 red seal stamps, one on the left mid-lower area and one small seal near the lower-right text. Use elegant black typography, subtle gray ink traces, soft diffuse lighting, ultra-detailed product rendering, cultural luxury branding, serene yet powerful mood, and a balanced blend of ancient mythic artifact presentation and contemporary high-end Chinese poster design.

title: 乡村火车站的动漫女仆
content: A highly detailed anime-style illustration of a quiet rural Japanese train station platform in bright summer daylight, with a full-body young woman in the foreground wearing a classic black-and-white Victorian maid dress. She stands slightly left of center on the platform, facing forward, holding out both sides of her skirt in a formal curtsy-like pose. Her outfit includes a black long-sleeved dress with white frilled trim, a large white apron, a white ruffled maid headband, white cuffs, white petticoat layers peeking from under the skirt, white socks, and black Mary Jane shoes. Use {{hair_color}} hair, straight and long with soft bangs. Her face should be obscured with a soft blurred mosaic block, as if anonymized. Behind her, on the nearest track, place an older cream-colored local train with a bold blue horizontal stripe, viewed from the front at a slight angle, with a destination sign reading "普通". On the right-side track, place a second train: a bright yellow local train farther back, also with "普通" on the front. Show 2 trains total. The station is an open-air, slightly nostalgic Japanese platform with overhead electrical lines, steel gantries, weathered wooden roofing, concrete platform edges, and yellow tactile paving. On the left, include a large station sign reading "のの", "Nono", and "福岡県福岡市", with directional arrows and the two destination labels "博多 Hakata" and "天神 Tenjin". Also show 2 platform number signs: "1 のりば" above the foreground platform and "2 のりば" on the opposite platform. Add small flowers near the base of the station sign, warm sunlight, crisp shadows, blue sky, and fluffy white summer clouds. Composition should feel like a polished slice-of-life anime background illustration with realistic rail details, clean linework, soft painterly shading, and a slightly nostalgic, cinematic mood.

title: 专业中文手相分析图
content: 请根据我上传的第一张手掌照片，结合第二张参考图的版式风格，生成一张高清 3:4 比例的中文掌纹解析图。 核心要求 请以第一张图中的真实手掌为主要分析对象，尽量保留原手掌的形态、手指比例、掌型、肤色、掌纹走向和真实质感。 第二张图只作为视觉风格参考： 参考它的中式玄学信息图风格、米白色背景、棕红色字体、传统书法标题、红色圆形编号、虚线引导线、掌纹线条标注、右侧文字分析栏、底部综合断语框。 不要照搬第二张图的手掌，不要复制水印，不要出现平台 logo。 画面风格 整体做成一张高级中式玄学风格的「掌纹解析图」。 画面比例：3:4 画质：高清、细节清晰、适合小红书发布 背景：米白色宣纸质感、淡淡复古纹理 主色：深棕色、红棕色、浅金色、米白色 字体风格：标题用中式书法感，正文用清晰可读的中文宋体/楷体风格 整体感觉：专业、古典、干净、高级，像传统命理大师出具的掌纹分析图卡。 标题设计 顶部大标题写： 「掌纹解析图」 副标题写： 「传统手相 · 易理参考 · 趋势分析」 标题旁边加一个红色小印章，印章文字写： 「天机」 底部小字写： 「仅供传统文化与娱乐参考」 手掌标注要求 请在手掌上用棕红色细线、虚线、圆点、编号标记出以下 12 个关键点。 每个编号要清晰对应右侧分析内容。 需要标注的 12 个点： 1. 生命线 2. 智慧线 3. 感情线 4. 命运线 5. 太阳线 6. 健康线 / 水星线 7. 婚姻线 8. 金星丘 9. 木星丘 10. 月丘 11. 拇指张开度 / 意志力 12. 手指形态与掌型 标注时要求： 线条要贴合第一张图真实掌纹的大致走向，不要乱画。 编号和文字不要遮挡手掌主体。 虚线引导线要像专业图解一样清晰。 手掌左侧、右侧和掌心内部都要有合理标注。 整体排版要像第二张图一样，左边是手掌解析图，右边是文字说明。 右侧分析文字要求 请在右侧生成 12 条中文分析，每条对应一个编号。 文字风格要像传统手相、易经、中医体质结合的分析，语言要专业、有预警感、有命理感，但不要太夸张。 每条控制在 2-4 行，文字清晰可读。 请使用以下分析内容： 1 生命线 弧度较大、整体不断，主精力底子不差，抗压后恢复力较强；中后段若显细碎，提示阶段性劳累与作息失衡时，要注意元气透支。 2 智慧线 线势偏长并略向下走，说明思维细腻、感受力强，做事有观察力与想象力；但也容易想得太多，情绪压力大时会反复内耗。 3 感情线 长度尚可，末端若有轻微分叉，代表感情认真、慢热，重投入也重精神契合；内心敏感，容易因期待高而失望。 4 命运线 掌心纵线偏淡，早年路径感不是一步到位，更多靠自己摸索累积；越到后期越稳，属于先试错、后定型的格局。 5 太阳线 太阳线偏细，名望运与成就感属于后发型，不是一夜爆发，而是靠作品、口碑、专业能力慢慢被看见。 6 健康线 / 水星线 此线偏隐，按传统中医观念，多提示脾胃、睡眠与情绪管理要放在前面；一紧张或熬夜，容易出现疲惫感与气血不足感。 7 婚姻线 侧缘细纹若不止一条，代表感情经历中有选择与衡量，不轻易定下；真正稳定往往来自成熟后的价值观契合。 8 金星丘 拇指根部较饱满，主重情义、顾家、生命力与亲和力较强；也说明对安全感和现实温度看得比较重。 9 木星丘 食指下方有一定起伏，代表上进心、自我要求与责任感不低；适合在团队中承担组织、带动、协调类角色。 10 月丘 掌缘下方纹理柔和，说明直觉、共情力与审美感不弱；想象力丰富，适合内容、审美、沟通相关事务。 11 拇指张开度 / 意志力 拇指张开角度自然，代表独立意识与执行意志较明显；不是盲从型，一旦想清楚方向，往往能持续推进。 12 手指形态与掌型 整体掌型偏长、手指较修长，属于理性中带感受型，重体验也重逻辑；做事不喜欢太粗糙，财运更适合稳扎稳打。 底部综合断语 请在画面底部设计一个古典边框信息框，标题写： 「综合断语」 内容写： • 整体格局偏中上，早年多摸索与变化，中后期逐步清晰并走向稳定累积。 • 性格理性务实而有同理心，适合以专业、审美、沟通或长期主义建立价值。 • 感情重真诚与精神契合，慢热但投入，成熟后更容易收获稳定关系。 • 近期最需注意的是作息、情绪与脾胃调养，守住状态，运势会更顺。 排版要求 左侧：放大手掌主体，占画面 55%-60%。 右侧：放 12 条编号分析，占画面 35%-40%。 底部：放综合断语框。 文字必须清晰、无乱码、无错别字、不要变形。 所有编号、线条、标题、正文要有统一的中式美学。 图片整体要像专业命理分析图，不要像普通手机截图。 不要出现英文。 不要出现水印。 不要改变原手掌的基本形状。 最终输出一张高清 3:4 中文掌纹解析海报。
description: 一份用于创作高清中文手相分析图的综合提示词。它复刻了传统美学风格，包含宣纸纹理、书法字体以及针对生命线、智慧线等掌纹的详细标注。 | Author: K哥 (https://x.com/weilai0205) | Source: https://x.com/weilai0205/status/2048394110822985990 | Published: 2026-04-26T13:29:47.000Z

title: 极简教育信息图模板
content:
一张干净的教育类信息图海报，讲解「{{知识主题}}」，

【整体风格】
现代极简UI风格，
背景使用柔和浅色（如奶油色 #FAF7F2 / 浅灰蓝），
配色克制、舒适，适合长时间阅读，

【核心要求（关键）】
根据“知识主题”的信息结构，自然组织内容模块，
不要强制固定模块数量或顺序，
优先保证信息逻辑清晰，而不是形式对称，

【布局（自适应）】
- 使用网格布局（自动选择 2列 / 3列 / 不规则分布）
- 卡片数量根据内容自动调整（通常 5–9 个）
- 信息密度高的模块可适当放大（视觉权重更高）
- 简单内容模块可缩小或合并

【卡片设计】
- 白色卡片（#FFFFFF）
- 圆角 + 轻微阴影（柔和层级）
- 保持统一间距和对齐

【每个信息模块包含】
- 简洁插图（统一风格）
- 清晰标题（强层级）
- 1–3句核心说明（避免冗长）
- 必要时提供示例 / 对比 / 小结

【内容组织原则（重点）】
根据主题自动选择合适结构，例如：
- 概念类 → 定义 + 原理 + 特点 + 示例
- 对比类 → A vs B（对照结构）
- 流程类 → 步骤 / 流程图
- 系统类 → 组成部分 + 关系
- 技能类 → 方法 + 技巧 + 常见误区

title: 奇幻 Q 版婚礼拼贴画
content: 一张梦幻般的奇幻婚礼拼贴画，采用柔和的粉彩色调和高细节的动漫游戏艺术风格。画面中，两位类似拉拉肥（lalafell）的 Q 版新婚夫妇身处华丽的教堂内，周围环绕着温暖的焦外成像光斑、淡蓝色与淡粉色的色调、鲜花以及飘落的粉色花瓣。画面中心是新郎新娘侧身靠近准备亲吻的特写，新娘在左，新郎在右。新娘是一位拥有尖耳朵的 Q 版奇幻角色，留着深棕色短发，圆润的脸颊带着淡淡的红晕，头戴由 2 朵白玫瑰、小白花和绿叶组成的白色大花饰，身后飘着长长的白色头纱。她身穿优雅的长袖白色蕾丝婚纱，配有精致的刺绣和镶钻领口。新郎也是一位拥有尖耳朵的 Q 版奇幻角色，留着棕色短碎发，发间插着白色百合花，佩戴红色流苏耳环；他身穿白色正式婚服，剪裁层次细腻，胸前别着绿叶白花胸花。在亲吻主场景周围，有 3 张带有奶油色边框的倾斜嵌入式照片：左上方是新郎向观众伸手的肖像，右上方是新娘展示手部并露出戒指的肖像，下方是一张两人在柔和阳光下户外并坐的双人照。画面中穿插着华丽的金色漩涡装饰线条和闪烁的光点，右下角前景处有一束淡奶油色和粉色的玫瑰花簇。背景是富丽堂皇的教堂内部，配有吊灯、蜡烛、柔和的花艺布置和明亮的粉彩薄雾。整体风格浪漫、空灵、精致且充满温情，呈现出奢华的婚礼相册质感，并采用适合智能手机浏览的竖版构图。

title: 可爱风水云菜（mozuku）制作指南信息图
content: Using the provided reference image of the packaged washed mozuku seaweed, transform it into a cute Japanese recipe infographic poster that teaches how to eat it properly. Keep the actual product recognizable by showing the package photo near the top and reuse the mozuku itself in small food/process photos, but redesign everything else as a bright, clean, blue-and-pink editorial layout. Add a cheerful anime catmaid guide character with pink hair and cat ears appearing multiple times as the instructor. Create a bold Japanese headline at the top: 「洗いもずくを 美味しく食べる手順書」 and a worker/name tag reading 「作業者：きらりあ・ネオン」. Build a 6-step vertical instruction flow on the left/middle with numbered circles 1 through 6 and arrows between them. The 6 step titles should be: 1「状態確認」 2「軽く水洗い」 3「水気を切る」 4「食べやすくカット」 5「味付け」 6「盛り付けて完成」. For each step, include a short Japanese explanation and a supporting image/illustration showing the mozuku at that stage; specifically include 1 package/close-up state check image, 1 rinsing-in-colander image, 1 draining colander image, 1 cutting-with-kitchen-scissors image, 3 seasoning option mini-boxes under step 5, and 1 finished bowl image under step 6. Add a right-side panel titled 「おすすめ具材」 with exactly 7 ingredients shown as small labeled illustrations: きゅうり, 長芋, オクラ, みょうが, 大葉, しらす, 豆腐. Add another right-side recommendation panel titled 「ネオンちゃんおすすめ」 containing exactly 2 dish cards labeled A and B: A「もずく酢きゅうり」 and B「もずくスープ」, each with a bowl image and ingredient list in Japanese. Add a bottom-right caution box titled 「注意」 with exactly 3 bullet points: 「洗いすぎない」「水気をしっかり切る」「開封後は早めに食べる」. Add a friendly footer banner in Japanese encouraging enjoyment of mozuku. Style it like a highly readable supermarket handout / cooking guide infographic with rounded boxes, glossy accents, clear hierarchy, and vibrant kawaii appeal.

title: 水彩风格 Minecraft 世界横截面
content: 一幅在纹理米白色纸张上绘制的高细节水彩插画，描绘了一个垂直悬浮的 Minecraft 风格世界切片，由一个巨大的废墟矩形石拱门框住。构图居中且呈纵向，边缘有柔和的云雾渲染，内部则有清晰的体素块细节。顶部，风化的拱门由长满苔藓的石头、裂开的砖块和矿物染色方块构成，像窗户一样敞开，展现出远处带有朦胧尖塔的奇幻山脉和 2 只飞鸟。在上层景观中，包含 2 棵方块树、2 座带斜屋顶的小村屋、中景处 1 座教堂式的塔楼、木栅栏、草地边缘，左侧有一条小瀑布，右侧边缘也有一条瀑布倾泻而下。在左中前景处放置 1 位背对着的 Steve 风格冒险家，身穿青色衬衫和蓝色裤子，手持镐子，凝视着拱门外的世界。在左上方的草地上添加 1 只猪。在地表之下，展示地下生物群系和结构的横截面：左侧有 1 个带有木支撑和矿车轨道的废弃矿井，中央洞穴有蓝色的水和垂直向下的梯子，左下角洞穴有 1 处发光的蓝色水晶矿，右侧有 1 条向下延伸的明亮橙色熔岩井，中右侧洞穴有 1 只绿色苦力怕，右侧小房间里有 1 只白色骷髅弓箭手，右下角附近有 1 个紫色的下界传送门，昏暗的下层房间里还有 1 只小蜘蛛。在洞穴中散布温暖的火把光以形成对比。色调应融合泥土棕色、苔藓绿、冷蓝色薄雾和炽热的橙色熔岩，远处呈现出梦幻的大气透视感。将整个场景渲染为 Minecraft 方块几何结构与传统水彩奇幻绘画的精致融合，复杂、神奇、怀旧且富有艺术感。

title: 艺术家与空灵缪斯之夜
content: A cinematic anime-inspired digital illustration set at night inside a cozy artist's room with large window panes and a warm city glow outside. On the left, a young male artist with {{hair_color}} messy hair sits at a cluttered desk in side profile, leaning forward with one hand near his mouth and the other drawing with a pen on a tablet or sketchbook. The desk is covered with exactly 1 pen cup filled with pencils, 1 coffee mug, 1 open laptop or pen-display showing a sunset landscape, 1 spiral sketchbook with manga-style character drawings, 2 additional drawing books or pads, 1 small stack of about 4 books, and many scattered art cards and printed illustrations. On the right, a luminous ethereal anime girl made of blue-white light appears life-sized, facing the artist with both hands gently extended toward him. Her form is translucent, delicate, and composed of glowing contour lines, starry particles, and flowing strands of light, with long windblown hair and a soft dress-like silhouette. Between them, a magical stream of golden and white light spirals upward from the artist's desk into the air, connecting creator and creation. Inside this swirling ribbon are exactly 12 to 16 floating image fragments and sketch pages: monochrome character sketches, scenic sunset paintings, small photo-like panels, and tiny icon-like cards, all orbiting in a curved arc from lower center to upper left and upper center. Around the upper half of the image, dozens of glowing musical notes float through the air, mixed with sparkling particles, creating the feeling that inspiration has become visible sound and memory. The palette is rich warm gold and amber on the artist's side, contrasted with cool electric blue and white on the spirit girl's side, with dramatic rim light, volumetric glow, intricate particles, and a dreamy emotional atmosphere. Composition is vertical, highly detailed, intimate, and poetic, evoking the relationship between {{person_one}} and {{person_two}} as artist and imagined muse, where drawings, music, memories, and fantasy physically manifest in the room. Add a small handwritten note card on the desk with {{note_text}}, and display one prominent artwork on the desk and one floating scenic panel using {{scene_theme}}.

content: 一张梦幻般的动漫风格全身插画，描绘了一位时尚的年轻女性在晴朗明媚的日子里站在东京涩谷十字路口中央。背景中心是标志性的圆柱形 SHIBUYA 109 大楼，周围环绕着极具辨识度的商业广告牌，包括类似 H&M、DHC、DMM TV、Big Echo 等密集的日本城市广告。她是画面中唯一的中心主体，姿态优雅，仿佛漂浮或处于失重状态，脚下踩着一个巨大的虹彩半透明肥皂泡。她的面部被柔和地遮挡并弱化处理，深紫黑色的长发在风中飘逸，留着柔和的刘海，一侧戴着带有丝带的粉色花朵头饰。她身着甜美的春季女性化服装：粉色无袖连衣裙内搭长袖荷叶边衬衫，胸前系有丝带，腰间系着棕色腰带，裙摆处有层叠的褶边，裙摆下部有精致的樱花刺绣。她的表情和肢体语言应显得温柔、优雅、奇幻且带有一丝魔法感。她的一只手向上抬起，食指指向一个漂浮的泡泡，泡泡内含 1 部智能手机；另一只手提着一个透明虹彩购物袋状的大泡泡，袋内可见 3 件物品：1 个 SHIBUYA 109 纸质购物袋、1 个粉色购物袋或包装，以及 1 个粉色小兔脸收纳袋。此外，在左下方泡泡外包含 1 个独立的漂浮智能手机/平板设备，右下方漂浮的泡泡内包含 1 台小型相机。周围环绕着许多大小不一的肥皂泡，所有泡泡都具有高反射性的彩虹光泽和细腻的透明感，营造出柔和闪烁的氛围。城市场景应显得繁忙但略带柔焦，远景中有行人，前景有斑马线，温暖的阳光穿过城市峡谷洒下。采用精致的高细节动漫插画渲染，使用明亮的柔和色调、光泽反射、柔光效果、浪漫的春季配色以及充满魔法感的东京日常美学。

title: 关键救援服监测 HUD
content: Create a dense futuristic Japanese sci-fi emergency HUD screen, a full-screen suit telemetry dashboard for {{unit_name}}. Black background with glowing red and orange interface graphics, thin cyan-blue grid accents, distressed industrial UI styling, and a high-contrast cyberpunk control-room aesthetic. The display is a single unified monitoring panel divided into 12 clearly separated sections with Japanese titles and smaller English subtitles. Top header bar: left title block reading "ソルジャンヌ・スーツ 外部モニタリングシステム" with English subtitle "SOLJENNE SUIT EXTERNAL MONITORING SYSTEM" and a small red "LIVE" tag; center red warning banner reading "WARNING", "危険レベル: 最大", and "DANGER LEVEL : MAXIMUM"; right identity block with 4 elements, the text "UNIT ID : SOLJENNE", "STATUS : CRITICAL", "MODE : RESCUE / EMERGENCY", and a red triangular logo above the word "SOLBRAIN" with subtitle "RESCUE & MEDICAL SUPPORT". Middle-left section titled "全身ステータス / OVERALL STATUS" showing system condition "危険 / CRITICAL", system integrity "18%", a waveform graph, and 5 vital readouts: heart rate 136 bpm, body temp 39.8°C, SpO2 72%, blood pressure 90 / 60 mmHg, plus one additional label line for heart beat status. title: 硬派黑色电影风格漫画女性页面
content: A gritty black-and-white hard-boiled manga page in a high-contrast ink wash style, arranged as a single comic page with 9 distinct panels of varying sizes and diagonal borders. The main subject is a mysterious adult woman with {{hair_color}} long messy hair, a curvy build, an off-shoulder dark knit dress or sweater, a choker necklace, and dangling cross earrings, portrayed as a noir antiheroine. Her face is intentionally obscured by shadow, blur, or framing in multiple panels, giving her an anonymous and dangerous presence. The page uses dramatic brush textures, rain-soaked urban grime, splattered ink, heavy blacks, and cinematic lighting. Panel 1 at the top left shows a nighttime city skyline under rain with glowing windows and the vertical Japanese narration text: 「この街はいつも雨が降っている」. Panel 2 at the top center is a bust portrait of the woman facing forward, hair spilling across her shoulders, with her face obscured. Panel 3 at the top right shows her from behind walking down a narrow alley or wet street, with the vertical text: 「あたしの名前は誰も知らない」. Panel 4 in the middle left is an extreme close-up of one eye with the vertical text: 「知ってるのは裏の顔だけ」. Panel 5 in the middle center-left shows an overhead urban scene of buildings or city blocks with the vertical text: 「金と嘘と裏切りがこの街のルール」. Panel 6 in the middle center-right shows a close-up of hands, money, or a violent underworld exchange with the vertical text: 「でもあたしはそのルールの外側で生きてる」. Panel 7 in the middle right is a dark partial close-up of the woman in shadow with the vertical text: 「守るものなんか最初からなかった」. Panel 8 at the lower left is a medium shot of the woman standing with folded arms, with the vertical text: 「あるのは譲れないたったひとつの信念だけ」, and below it a small inset panel of 2 people seated at a bar counter at night with bottles and dim lights, accompanied by the vertical text: 「夜が明けるまでに片をつける」. Panel 9, the dominant lower-right panel, shows the woman aiming a handgun directly at the viewer in extreme foreshortening, hair whipping, body angled forward, with bold large vertical Japanese text split across the panel: 「あたしの正義は」 and 「あたしが決める」. Keep all visible text in Japanese exactly as written. Emphasize a seinen crime manga aesthetic, hard-boiled female vigilante energy, wet neon-noir atmosphere, rough pen lines, ink splatter, and dramatic panel composition.

She has short wavy auburn-brown hair, pointed elf ears, large iridescent translucent butterfly wings, a sparkling silver beret, a fitted white shimmering top, a short holographic metallic skirt, and glowing white shoes. Her face area is deliberately obscured by a centered square censor block in warm brown. The composition is packed like a blockbuster teaser poster, with glowing Japanese typography and social-media-style callout panels arranged around the character. At the very top, large luminous Japanese text reads: 「そのひと言が、誰かの明日を燃やす。」. Across the upper left is 1 profile card panel showing a circular avatar, a Japanese display name with blue verification badge, handle, bio text, link, and follower count, styled like an X profile screenshot. On the left side there are 3 additional stacked callout panels: panel 1 says 「フォロワー 11,000+人 いつもありがとう！」 with a follower icon; panel 2 says 「今日のAI解説 生成AIってなに？ 初心者向けやさしく解説」 and includes a thumbnail card with small engagement counts; panel 3 says 「アイデア → 作品へ AI × 創造力で あなただけの物語を。」 with small creative tool icons. Across the lower middle, add a handwritten glowing phrase in blue-white: 「想いを カタチに。」. Below it, the giant main title in blazing molten brush-style Japanese lettering reads: 「未来は、つくれる。 タイムラインの 妖精アーヤ」, with an English subtitle underneath in small serif capitals: “FAIRY AYA OF THE TIMELINE”. Beneath the title, add dense film-credit style lines in Japanese, including creator/AI/video references, then a centered starring line: 「主演：妖精アーヤ」 with small wings. At the very bottom, place a huge release notice in bold glowing Japanese text: 「近日公開」, and to its right a rounded dark plaque with gold border that says: 「未来は、つくれる。」. Add a small butterfly emblem near the lower right. content: 一间宁静的日式茶室，以精致的单色水墨画风格呈现于陈旧的羊皮纸上，色调为柔和的深褐色与灰色，笔触细腻，线条勾勒精准。在右侧，一个 {{robot_type}} 人形机器人正跪坐在榻榻米上，其光滑的白色外壳和裸露的机械关节以优雅的工业细节呈现，它低头垂目，正将热茶从铸铁茶壶中缓缓倒入小巧的陶瓷杯里。机器人腰间系着简单的布围裙，将传统的茶道礼仪与未来主义机械感完美融合。画面中央前景处，一张低矮的黑色木制茶桌上清晰可见 5 件茶具：1 个深色陶瓷花瓶，插着一枝稀疏的叶片；1 个直立的竹制茶筅；1 个茶碗；1 个托盘上的小茶杯；以及机器人手中持有的 1 把铸铁茶壶。刚沏好的茶冒着淡淡的热气。桌后悬挂的卷轴上绘有一个笔触洒脱的圆相（Enso）。左侧，高大的障子门将柔和的日光漫射进室内。墙壁为素雅的灰泥墙，带有细微的磨损和墨渍，整体构图平静、平衡、极简且引人深思，将日式“侘寂”美学与静谧的科幻感融为一体。采用宽银幕电影构图，平视视角，留白充足，营造出一种冥想般的氛围。

title: 黏土宇航员月球市集
content: 一个充满奇趣的手工黏土立体模型，主题为 {{scene_theme}}，拍摄效果如同微缩电影布景。地面是布满小型陨石坑且质感不均的灰尘月壤，背景是深邃的黑色天空，点缀着许多微小的暖白色星星，左上方可见一颗布满陨石坑的月球。画面中有 5 个穿着厚实复古风格白色宇航服的小宇航员，他们戴着圆润的头盔和深色光泽面罩，分别扮演市集摊主和顾客。搭建 4 个由粗糙木杆和石质柜台组成的乡村风市集摊位，每个摊位上方都覆盖着柔和的蓝灰色或锈红色织物遮阳棚。摊位上悬挂着暖橙色的纸灯笼，摊位后方串联着 6 个圆形灯泡，与寒冷的月球环境形成舒适的对比。在左侧前景处，放置一个大型摊位，有 2 个宇航员：1 名摊主在柜台后用碗盘盛放食物，1 名背着背包的顾客面向摊位。在中景背景处，放置 2 个较小的摊位，有 1 个宇航员站在摊位之间或附近，仿佛在浏览或购买商品。在右侧前景处，放置一个红色遮阳棚的摊位，摆满了面包、糕点、罐子和篮子。在中心前方附近，添加一张粗糙的圆形石桌和 4 个低矮的圆凳；一个宇航员坐在旁边，手里拿着杯子或碗，桌面上摆放着 4 个小盘子或食物组合。在场景周围散落几个铝箔包裹的银色货箱，包括左侧前景的 1 个和右侧的一组。整体风格应具有触感和手工感，如同定格动画木偶和雕塑黏土微缩模型，具有细腻的纹理、来自灯笼的温暖实用照明、浅景深，以及太空探索与舒适街头美食市集之间迷人而超现实的融合。

title: Good Bath Day 编辑海报
content: Create a soft editorial lifestyle poster for {{event_date}} celebrating Japanese bath culture, designed like a refined magazine feature page in portrait orientation. The layout is split into two main columns with a pale cream and warm gray background, thin divider lines, elegant serif typography, and muted sage-green accents. At the top left, include the small heading “LIFESTYLE / FEATURE”, then a large date line reading “{{event_date}} EVENT”, followed by the large Japanese title “よい風呂の日” and the subtitle “特集” in sage green, with a small bathtub icon nearby. Beneath that, add the Japanese tagline “心も体も、ととのう時間。” and several short body-text blocks in Japanese explaining the meaning of Good Bath Day, including references to “4（よ）2（ふ）6（ろ）” and the benefits of bathing for body and mind. On the right side, show a bright, airy bathroom interior lit by soft natural morning light from a window, with beige and off-white tones, a wooden counter, folded white towels, a pump bottle, a sponge, woven baskets, and a few green plants. In front of the bathroom scene, place a youthful anime-style person with {{hair_color}} tousled short hair, fair skin, and a relaxed expression, standing in a casual post-bath pose. The character wears a loose white T-shirt with a tiny dark square chest logo and light brown drawstring lounge pants, one hand in a pocket and the other holding a white towel up near the face and shoulder, conveying a fresh, just-bathed feeling. Near the character, include the handwritten-style Japanese side note “湯上がりの、リラックスタイム。” Add an oval badge on the lower right of the main image area with the English heading “GOOD BATH DAY” and Japanese explanatory text inside, plus a small bathtub icon. Below the main feature, include exactly 2 small inset images of the same character in the bathroom, each framed as rectangular mini-panels with narrow vertical Japanese captions beside them. At the bottom, create exactly 4 rounded rectangular information cards in a row: card 1 labeled “POINT 01” with the heading “お風呂の基本” and text about soaking in lukewarm water around 38–40°C; card 2 labeled “POINT 02” with the heading “日常でできること” and text about making bathing part of a routine instead of only showering; card 3 labeled “POINT 03” with the heading “楽しみ方・取り入れ方” and text about bath salts, scents, music, and lighting; card 4 labeled “まとめ” with concluding Japanese text about sustainable self-care. Decorate the cards with small illustrated elements such as leaves, a bathtub, a candle, a bottle, lavender sprigs, and a basket of folded towels. Along the very bottom, add a horizontal green tip strip labeled “今日からできる TIP” with exactly 3 checklist items: “就寝の１〜２時間前に入浴する”, “スマホは浴室に持ち込まない”, and “水分補給を忘れずに”. Place a final handwritten-style Japanese phrase at the lower right reading “自分をいたわる時間を。” The overall look should be clean, gentle, wellness-focused, feminine-neutral, and polished like a Japanese seasonal magazine infographic, with delicate anime illustration, soft shadows, subtle textures, and calm spa-like atmosphere.

title: 深蓝底色上的无缝金玫瑰
content: 一种设计为四向连续壁纸或织物印花的无缝重复纺织图案，以深午夜蓝为背景，呈现金属古金色的复古玫瑰花束。构图应在所有方向上整齐平铺，无可见接缝，排列为玫瑰簇、半开花朵、小花蕾、卷曲茎秆和散落叶片的优雅全覆盖重复图案。使用精致的蚀刻或提花风格线条纹理，使花朵看起来像是编织、刺绣或雕刻而成，而非绘画。花束的比例应从中等到大型不等，密集的簇群与较小的独立花朵交替出现，以形成平衡的重复效果。调色板仅限于浓郁的深蓝色和明亮的柔和金色，具有强烈的对比感以及奢华、深沉、经典的巴洛克时尚纺织品质感。在表面添加非常细微的垂直阴影褶皱，使其看起来像垂下的织物或窗帘，同时保持无缝重复结构。高细节、装饰性、优雅、富丽堂皇，无缝图案样本，适用于室内装潢、壁纸或奢华服装面料。

title: 热带鹦鹉像素马赛克
content: 一幅充满活力的像素艺术风格马赛克作品，描绘了一只栖息在茂密雨林枝头的小型热带鹦鹉。整幅图像由紧密排列的微小方形瓷砖构成，带有明显的黑色轮廓，呈现出彩色玻璃或 LED 屏幕的视觉效果。鹦鹉呈侧面朝右，拥有巨大的黑色弯曲喙、奶油色的面部、鲜艳的红橙色前额和喉部，上半身呈鲜绿色，长长的翅膀和尾巴则为饱和的蓝色与青色。周围的丛林铺满了层层叠叠、深浅不一的绿色叶片，鹦鹉背后散发着柔和的浅绿色光芒，使其从背景中脱颖而出。高色彩对比度、丰富的热带色调、清晰的瓷砖纹理、居中构图，极具装饰性的数字马赛克美学。
description: 一幅色彩斑斓的热带鹦鹉马赛克拼贴插画，背景为茂密的热带丛林，非常适合生成装饰性的像素艺术或彩色玻璃风格的自然图像。 | Author: Erik MacKinnon (https://x.com/erikmackinnon) | Source: https://x.com/erikmackinnon/status/2048190288179675290#reversed-0 | Published: 2026-04-25T23:59:52.000Z

title: 水墨蚀刻风格全家福
content: 一张黑白手绘全家福，采用细腻的钢笔交叉排线风格，呈现于带有纹理的白纸之上，画面中 4 人紧密坐在一起，构图自然随性。左侧是一位成年男性，头戴反向棒球帽，身穿深色 T 恤，身体向画面中心倾斜，胸前斜挎着一个带有明显拉链细节的单肩包。右侧是一位留着卷发并扎成松散高丸子头的成年女性，身穿浅色 T 恤，上面印有醒目的大号学院风字母 {{shirt_text}}。中间坐着两个紧挨在一起的幼童，两人都留着短卷发，穿着印满草莓图案的浅色配套 T 恤。左侧的孩子向内倾斜，一只手臂搭在另一个孩子身上，右侧的孩子头部微微上扬。大人们从两侧保护性地环绕着孩子，营造出温馨的家庭快照氛围。将整张图像渲染为单色蚀刻插画，运用密集的细线排线、雕刻般的阴影和清晰的轮廓线，在保持写实的同时兼具艺术感；画面无色彩，背景仅为纯净的浅色纸张纹理，采用竖构图。

title: 复古雕刻风格连帽衫肖像
content: 一张居中的黑白复古雕刻风格肖像，描绘了一位蓄须男子，他穿着连帽衫并戴着兜帽，兜帽下露出反戴的棒球帽。仅展示头部和上半身，背景为带有细微纹理的素色米白色纸张。以细腻的钢笔画蚀刻风格呈现，运用密集的交叉排线、精细的平行线条以及古籍插画般的阴影效果。人物面朝前方，姿态沉稳自然。棒球帽前额处可见调节扣带，帽檐上方露出向后梳理的头发，面部下方留有浓密的络腮胡。连帽衫胸前垂下两条抽绳。构图保持对称且紧凑，如同经典的雕刻半身像，无色彩，无现代图形元素，背景中无其他物体。

title: 温室酒吧里的金色鸡尾酒
content: 一张电影质感的竖构图照片，展示了一只手举起一个巨大的气球状葡萄酒杯，杯中盛着闪烁的金色柑橘鸡尾酒，背景是郁郁葱葱的室内温室酒吧。饮品被午后温暖的阳光逆光照射，呈现出半透明的琥珀色光泽。杯中可见 1 片柑橘，杯缘装饰着 1 簇新鲜薄荷。手从左下方伸入，优雅地握住杯柄，手腕上戴着 1 只厚实的半透明琥珀色手镯。环境布满了热带绿植、悬挂的蕨类植物和藤蔓覆盖的墙壁，上方可见明亮的温室屋顶结构，背景中有 2 个温暖的悬挂灯泡在柔和地发光。使用浅景深和奶油般的虚化效果，强烈的阳光透过叶片过滤，带有柔和的雾气，形成浓郁的绿金色彩对比。在右边缘添加一片模糊的前景叶子或植物来构图。背景下方应暗示一个繁忙的咖啡馆或鸡尾酒吧，有模糊的人影，但需保持高度虚化。照片级逼真，优雅的生活方式摄影，氛围感十足且阳光明媚，采用低角度仰拍举起的酒杯，展现冷凝水、玻璃反射和发光饮品的高细节。
description: 此提示词可生成一张照片级逼真的生活方式图像，展示在郁郁葱葱的温室环境中举起一杯发光的柑橘鸡尾酒，非常适合用于饮料编辑、酒店业或社交媒体视觉内容。 | Author: Kaique Fernandes (https://x.com/FernandesK47117) | Source: https://x.com/FernandesK47117/status/2048183925294371147#reversed-0 | Published: 2026-04-25T23:34:35.000Z

title: 动漫博物馆背景转换
content: 使用提供的参考照片，将博物馆外立面及正面构图重绘为精致的剧场版动漫背景插画。保持建筑结构、标识、3 根旗杆、宽阔台阶及整体布局的一致性，但将图像从写实摄影转换为高细节的手绘动漫电影风格，要求线条清晰、采用柔和的赛璐璐阴影、淡雅的石材色调以及清澈的氛围光影。在右上角添加戏剧性的阳光，使玻璃金字塔在中央墙面及入口左侧投下大面积的几何网格阴影。将人物简化并风格化为动漫背景角色，保留 2 组可见人群：左侧 1 个单独的人物，以及入口中右侧 7 人组成的小型群体。在保持晴朗蓝天白昼氛围的同时，使画面呈现出优雅、精致且具有电影感的视觉效果。

title: 神奇种子包立体模型
content:
宏大的 3D 场景：一个风化的种子包敞开在盆栽工作台上，其承诺的内容喷涌而出，化作了它所描述的花园。包装正面的插图变成了现实。从纸张中全比例生长出的 {{plant_type}}，根部透过包装底部清晰可见，扎入下方的土壤中。
角落处盛开的 {{detail_left}}。另一侧处于生长中期的 {{detail_right}}，尚未完全成形。
属于该植物的微小昆虫 {{insect_type}}，以正确的比例悬浮在空中。

种子包与土壤之间散落着种子，每一颗都展示着发芽的不同阶段：种皮裂开、初生根、初生芽、初生叶。
包装撕裂的顶部边缘变成了树线。
盆栽工作台表面散落着土壤和水滴。
移轴摄影景深，温室晨光，让种子包成为它本应成为的花园。

content: 一张极具张力的奢华产品广告图，展示了暗调摄影棚中赛车灵感计时腕表。画面左前方中心位置，放置一块不锈钢计时码表，呈微微侧向的三分之二角度直立，配有黑色表盘、两个红色点缀的小表盘、纤细的银色时标、测速计表圈，右侧可见表冠和按钮。腕表配有黑色皮质表带，边缘饰有醒目的红色缝线，呈现出运动型高端质感。腕表右侧放置一个略微靠后的黑色方形礼盒，具有皮革纹理，盒盖周围有红色缝线，上方印有银色浮雕眼形徽标，下方文字为“NESS STUDIO”，更小的红色文字为“TRACK SURFACE”。构图顶部中心位置，添加相同的银色眼形徽标，下方配有“NESS STUDIO”字样及较小的“BY NICOLAS”。背景处放置一个超大且模糊的单词，{{headline_text}}，采用巨大的灰色大写字母，几乎横跨整个画面宽度。场景设定在深黑色背景下，红色和白色的水平光束从左至右穿过产品后方，营造出速度感和赛道氛围。使用带有反射纹理的亮面湿润地面，在腕表和礼盒下方映出红色高光和镜面反射。底部中心位置添加“CHRONOGRAPH SERIES”字样，采用简洁的白色等间距大写字母，两侧延伸出细长的红色水平线，下方配有较小的红色大写字母 {{tagline_text}}。配色方案：黑色、炭灰色、银色钢质、鲜艳的赛车红以及少许白色。灯光应具备高对比度和高级感，金属表壳上呈现清晰的镜面高光，礼盒上有柔和的补光，并带有深邃的阴影。整体风格：极致精美的商业产品摄影，奢华腕表宣传大片，产品焦点清晰，品牌感流畅，具备高端汽车美学。
description: 一张高端暗调摄影广告图，展示了品牌赛车风格计时码表及礼盒，非常适合奢华产品营销和腕表宣传视觉。 | Author: nazca alwave (https://x.com/AlwaveNazca) | Source: https://x.com/AlwaveNazca/status/2048147643809865950#reversed-1 | Published: 2026-04-25T21:10:25.000Z

title: Nike Lumina 霓虹广告海报
content: 一张充满活力的 Nike 竖版时尚营销海报，画面中一位年轻的女性运动员在未来主义霓虹影棚背景下腾空跳跃。她呈现出动态的空中姿态：一膝上屈，另一腿向后折叠，一只手臂向外伸展，另一只手臂弯曲靠近胸前，传达出动感与力量。她的面部被一个居中的简洁矩形模糊块遮挡。她身穿一件带有黑色拉链的短款炫彩白色连帽风衣，胸前印有小巧的 Nike 标志；穿着带有淡紫色金属光泽的全息紧身裤，大腿处有隐约的 Nike Swoosh 标志；紧身裤上方露出的黑色品牌腰带清晰可见，脚蹬厚底白色 Nike 运动鞋。她的棕色头发扎成高马尾，随跳跃动作向外飞扬。在她身后，巨大的发光白色衬线字母拼写出“NIKE”，上方居中处有一个小巧的白色 Nike Swoosh。背景中部，“LUMINA”字样以宽大、加粗且发光的形式呈现，带有水平故障和扫描线失真效果，部分被模特遮挡。色调采用高饱和度的洋红色、紫罗兰色、青色和电光蓝，并带有强烈的辉光、光泽高光、镜头光晕和色差效果。在模特腿部和身体周围添加环绕的弧形光轨，以体现速度与动感。整体风格为高端运动服饰广告，极致精致、电影感强、高对比度、超写实修图、产品细节清晰、戏剧性的轮廓光，以及发光的全息美学。在底部放置两行小字：左下角为 {{tagline_text}}，右下角为 {{collection_name}}，后跟一个小巧的 Nike Swoosh。画面中总共包含 3 个清晰可见的 Nike Swoosh：1 个位于大型 NIKE 标题上方，1 个位于夹克胸前，1 个位于紧身裤上。
description: 一张光泽感十足的未来主义运动服饰广告海报，展示了一位身着 Nike 炫彩服饰的跳跃运动员，非常适合时尚营销、品牌样机及高能量健身推广。 | Author: nazca alwave (https://x.com/AlwaveNazca) | Source: https://x.com/AlwaveNazca/status/2048147643809865950#reversed-2 | Published: 2026-04-25T21:10:25.000Z

title: 街头风运动鞋海报广告
content: 为 {{brand_name}} 创作一张大胆的街头风海报广告。画面中，一位年轻模特以低角度时尚姿势随意坐在地上，一只膝盖弯曲，另一条腿伸向镜头，使前方的运动鞋看起来超大且极具视觉冲击力。模特身穿深棕色廓形皮质飞行员夹克、黑色内搭、浅蓝色宽松牛仔裤和白色袜子，脚蹬黑白灰配色厚底运动鞋，鞋底带有红色点缀，鞋侧和鞋舌处清晰可见 {{brand_name}} 的品牌 Logo。模特的脸部被中心位置的一个柔和矩形模糊块刻意遮挡。背景采用米白色纹理纸张，融合做旧的 Grunge 风格设计元素与拼贴图层。在模特身后，放置一个横跨画面中心的粗犷红色大号笔触形状。添加黑色墨点、手绘圆圈、撕裂的纸屑和手绘涂鸦装饰。包含 4 个主要图形涂鸦：右上角的一个大号黑色“X”，左下角的一个手绘向上箭头，右下角的一个粗糙皇冠草图，以及顶部中心附近的一个圆形涂鸦。在左上角，放置一个风格化的眼睛 Logo，下方文字为 "{{brand_name}}"，再下方配有一句较小的标语 "A MOMENT OF YOUR STYLE"。在左侧中部区域，添加手写风格的堆叠式黑色笔刷字体标语 "INNOVATE CREATE INSPIRE"。在右侧中部区域，放置一块撕裂的黑色纸质贴片，上面写有白色手写标语 "BUILT DIFFERENT MOVE DIFFERENT" 并带有红色下划线。在左下角靠近鞋子的地方，添加一张黑色做旧标签贴纸，包含一个地球涂鸦、文字 "{{brand_name}}" 以及一个条形码。沿底部页脚处，创建一个简洁的水平条，放置 3 个社交媒体图标及账号，中间用细竖线分隔：Instagram、Facebook 和 Twitter，每个图标后均标注 "@NESS.STUDIO"。整体风格应呈现出前卫、都市、年轻、高对比度的编辑级街头时尚感，将产品广告摄影与涂鸦海报设计、拼贴纹理及动态品牌元素完美融合。

content: A dramatic anime concert illustration seen from behind the performers onstage, showing 4 teenage girls standing shoulder to shoulder at the front of a huge indoor arena, arms around each other in a triumphant post-performance moment. The camera is positioned slightly behind and below them, facing out toward the audience and the giant venue screen. The atmosphere is dazzling and emotional, filled with dense blue-and-gold confetti, sparkling particles, and strong white stage spotlights pouring down from above. The crowd fills the entire arena as a sea of tiny glowing blue lights. At center top, a giant rectangular screen displays elegant serif concert text: {{band_name}}, "1st LIVE at 日本武道館", {{concert_date}}, and "SOLD OUT". Show their backs and silhouettes rim-lit by stage light, with soft highlights on their hair. Include stage equipment: a microphone stand and part of a bass neck at the far left, and a visible drum kit with cymbals at the right edge. The stage floor is glossy and reflective, covered with scattered confetti and several blue flower bouquets near the bottom foreground. Use rich midnight blues, violet shadows, warm golden sparkles, and cinematic bloom. The mood should feel like a sold-out dream performance finale, sentimental, victorious, and breathtakingly luminous, in highly detailed painterly anime style.

title: Editorial Osaka Six 卫衣广告
content: 一张干净的编辑风格时尚广告海报，背景为淡粉蓝色摄影棚，地面带有光泽的反射效果。构图呈垂直且极简风格，背景上方被巨大的白色加粗无衬线字体占据，第一行写着“OSAKA SIX:”，下方写着“006 REMAINS”，填满了主体后方的上半部分。右上角有小号白色品牌文字，写着“Designed by ARTTEESHOW”。画面中下部居中位置是一件巨大的森林绿色圆领卫衣，像雕塑一样竖立着，采用柔软厚实的棉质面料，落肩设计，超长袖子堆叠在地面上，领口处有一个写着 ARTTEESHOW 的黑色小标签。卫衣胸前有一个巨大的抽象拼贴印花，由米色、棕褐色、黑色、灰色、白色和鲜红色的撕纸碎片组成，像层叠的碎屑一样垂直排列。靠在巨大卫衣右侧的是一位身材苗条的女性时尚模特，留着黑色长直发，穿着同款 {{sweatshirt_color}} 卫衣和宽松的阔腿运动裤，脚踩干净的白色低帮运动鞋。她侧身站立，展现出一种冷静、疏离的编辑风格态度，一只手插在口袋里，身体斜靠在巨大的服装上，双腿向前伸展；她的脸部被柔和的矩形模糊处理，营造出一种匿名艺术时尚感。模特身上穿着的较小号卫衣胸前也有同样的抽象撕纸拼贴图案。在底部中心，添加两行白色小字文案：“Made for comfort, worn for confidence.”以及“Because life feels better when someone’s carrying the weight of the world.” 画面应呈现出 20 世纪 90 年代初的高端概念街头服饰广告风格，并以当代奢华广告的形式重新演绎，具备清晰的摄影棚灯光、柔和的阴影、微妙的地面反射、精准的产品对焦、巨大卫衣与模特之间的超现实比例对比，以及精致的杂志海报美学。

title: 道教三魂七魄海报
content: A highly detailed vertical Taoist esoteric infographic poster in the style of an ancient Chinese religious scroll, printed on aged beige rice paper with fine ornamental borders, inked calligraphy, faded stains, and classical diagram annotations. At the top center, large black brush-calligraphy title text reads {{headline_text}}. Directly below the title is a smaller paragraph of classical Chinese explanatory text in neat calligraphy. The composition is perfectly symmetrical and centered on a glowing vertical spiritual axis made of white-gold energy, mist, and lightning-like qi currents running from the bottom of the page to the heavens. At the very top, above the axis, depict 3 seated Taoist immortals or deities on clouds in a golden celestial realm, arranged left, center, and right, with halos and flowing robes in muted green, cream, and blue. Beneath them, create a towering multi-layered cosmological body diagram made of 9 stacked circular realms or platforms connected by swirling clouds and luminous energy. The upper 5 larger realms represent the five zang organs as miniature mythic landscapes: 1 forested green realm labeled liver/wood, 1 fiery red-gold temple city realm labeled heart/fire, 1 yellow earth realm with terraces labeled spleen/earth, 1 silver-blue mountain-and-water realm labeled lung/metal, and 1 dark blue watery abyss realm labeled kidney/water. Place a glowing meditating figure in a bright orb at the center junction between the upper organ realms and lower spirit layers. Below these, add 7 progressively darker circular underworld-like realms for the seven po souls, each densely populated with tiny scenes of human figures, spirits, beasts, ritual activity, suffering, temptation, conflict, and karmic symbolism, all wrapped by drifting smoke and energy ribbons. At the very bottom, show a seated human figure in meditation within a root-like cavern or corporeal foundation, surrounded by chains, rocks, and embodied worldly attachments. Around the central column, include exactly 9 labeled side panels and diagrams in traditional Chinese layout: top left a bagua and yin-yang cosmology circle; top right a dotted numerological or constellation-like chart; left upper a boxed list for 3 souls; right upper a boxed list for 7 po souls; left middle a five-elements relationship diagram with 5 colored nodes; right middle a circular essence-qi-spirit cycle diagram with 3 nodes; left lower a vertical boxed list of 7 categories or stages; right lower a boxed correspondence table; bottom left a five-direction and five-element human-body relation chart; bottom right a standing and seated meridian or cultivation body diagram. Use many small Chinese labels throughout every section, with classical seal stamps in red. The overall palette is antique parchment, sepia ink, muted jade, cinnabar red, smoky gray, gold, teal, and indigo. The style should feel like a museum-quality Daoist metaphysical chart, ultra intricate, hand-painted gongbi plus ink wash illustration, sacred, mystical, scholarly, dense with symbolism, extremely fine linework, soft cloud layering, and high-resolution poster design.

content: Create a vintage editorial poster on aged rice paper celebrating {{artist_name}}, designed like a museum infographic mixed with Chinese ink wash illustration and calligraphy. The format is a single vertically oriented poster with a weathered parchment background, ink splatters, faded handwritten annotations, red seal stamps, and a scholarly, archival atmosphere. At the very top, place large black Chinese calligraphy for the name 鄭問, followed by a slash and the romanized name {{romanized_name}} in large serif capitals, with a small red seal beside it. Under the title, add the subtitle {{subtitle_text}} in elegant reddish-brown serif text. In the center, feature a dramatic painterly scene of 1 seated male artist in a loose white shirt at a desk, holding a brush over paper, his face intentionally obscured by a soft rectangular blur. Behind him, surround him with a swirling halo-like storm of monochrome ink-brush warriors and historical figures: exact count 9 visible character figures, including armored generals, swordsmen, and mounted riders, emerging from explosive black brushwork and smoke-like ink textures. On the left side, create a vertical section titled “Life & Milestones” with a black brushstroke header and smaller Chinese subtitle text. List exactly 6 timeline entries with red year markers and bilingual captions: 1958 born in Taiwan, 1983 Warrior Panther, 1989 Abi Sword, 1990 Heroes of the Eastern Zhou, 1991 Japan Cartoonists Association Award, 2017 legacy continues. Below that, add a small section titled “Ink in Detail” containing exactly 4 boxed brush studies labeled with short English captions: Dry brush texture, Ink wash gradient, Splatter energy, Bold contour line. On the right side, create a vertical section titled “Visual Method” with a black brushstroke header and smaller Chinese subtitle text. Include exactly 5 stacked boxed studies with image-and-caption layout: Brush as blade, Ink as atmosphere, Anatomy as fate, History as theatre, Speed lines become calligraphy. In the lower center, create a section titled “Major Works Constellation” with a dark brushstroke heading. Arrange exactly 5 circular work nodes around a central ink ring with Chinese calligraphy inside. Label the 5 nodes: Abi Sword, Heroes of the Eastern Zhou, Assassin Biographies, Magical Super Asia, Game character design legacy. Each circle contains a distinct monochrome or muted-color ink illustration, with subtle connecting marks like a constellation diagram. At the lower right, add a section titled “Studio Notes” containing exactly 6 visible objects: 4 hanging calligraphy brushes, 1 ink bowl, and 1 painter’s palette with blue and red pigment; beneath them place a sketchbook page with light pencil figure studies. Across the bottom, add a wide section titled “Why He Matters” with a black brushstroke header and smaller Chinese subtitle text, followed by a paragraph of serif body text in English describing his importance to comics, painting, calligraphy, cinema, and epic storytelling. Use a restrained palette of sepia, black ink, off-white paper, muted gray, with small accents of deep red and occasional blue. The whole image should feel like a refined cultural tribute poster, dense but balanced, highly detailed, painterly, and authentic to Chinese ink aesthetics.

content:
A polished vertical infographic poster in elegant East Asian editorial style, themed around the fire signs of the zodiac using one consistent female character reimagined in three different costumes. Cream parchment background with thin ornamental borders, small corner flourishes, tiny sparkles, and warm red-orange-gold accents throughout. Use the same young East Asian woman in all 3 panels, slim build, long dark hair in a high ponytail, shown from about thigh-up to waist-up, facing slightly toward camera, styled as a fashion-model zodiac character sheet. Keep facial features neutral and refined, clean beauty lighting, soft airbrushed illustration-photo composite look.

Panel 1: Aries. Chinese title and English subtitle: "牡羊座 Aries". Dominant color scheme: vivid red with warm coral highlights. Zodiac symbol badge shows Aries glyph. Constellation on the right. Behind the character, faint circular mystical line art and flame motifs. title: 模糊复古像素鹦鹉丛林
content: 一幅复古像素艺术风格的插画，描绘了一只热带鹦鹉栖息在茂密丛林中央的一根棕色短树枝上。鸟儿呈侧面轮廓，面向右侧，拥有明亮的绿色身体、鲜艳的蓝色翅膀和长长的蓝色尾羽、黄色胸部、橙红色头部和颈部、眼周有白色斑块，以及一个巨大的弯曲黑色喙。鹦鹉是画面中唯一的中心主体，经过放大处理，并带有深色的像素边缘轮廓。周围环绕着填满整个画面的浓密雨林植被：层叠的绿叶、缠绕的藤蔓，以及两侧可见的树干，包括 2 根可见的树干和许多重叠的叶簇。在鹦鹉身后添加一个柔和的发光光环，将其与较暗的森林背景区分开来。采用方形构图、高饱和度色彩、经典的 16 位游戏精灵美学、粗犷可见的像素、低分辨率网格渲染，以及刻意柔和、模糊的像素边缘，而非现代清晰的像素艺术。整体氛围郁郁葱葱、充满活力且富有怀旧感，宛如老式电子游戏中的热带场景。

content: A cozy anime-style interior of a traditional Japanese soba restaurant, viewed from table height in a booth, with two young women seated across the near corners of a rectangular wooden table and facing the viewer in a casual dining snapshot. Place 2 large black bowls of soba on the table, one in front of each woman, both filled with dark broth, noodles, sliced duck meat, and chopped green onions; add 1 clear water glass near the center back of the table and 2 small condiment dishes beside it. title: 阿里山一日游旅行海报
content: Create a vintage illustrated travel poster in traditional Chinese for {{destination_name}}, designed as a one-day itinerary infographic with a split vertical layout. The left panel is a parchment-textured itinerary card in warm beige with ornate gold Art Nouveau borders and dark brown typography, and the right panel is a dramatic painted fantasy-realism map scene of a mountain journey at sunrise and sunset tones. At the top of the left panel, large headline text reads {{headline_text}}. Beneath it, include a short centered tagline in traditional Chinese: 「一座高山，五個經典景點。難忘的奇幻旅程。」 with a small decorative mountain divider. The left panel must contain exactly 5 numbered itinerary stops stacked vertically, each with a circular black-and-gold number badge, a small vignette illustration, a bold location name, a time in parentheses, and a short Chinese description. The 5 stops are: 1. 「阿里山車站」 at 「(8:00 AM)」 with a wooden mountain railway station illustration and description 「開啟探索神木與森林的旅程。」 2. 「阿里山森林鐵路」 at 「(9:30 AM)」 with a red-and-black steam train illustration and description 「穿越森林，體驗百年林鐵風情。」 3. 「神木區棧道」 at 「(11:30 AM)」 with giant cedar trees and elevated wooden boardwalk illustration and description 「漫步千年巨木下，感受森林靈氣。」 4. 「姊妹潭」 at 「(1:30 PM)」 with a tranquil forest lake and pavilion illustration and description 「欣賞靜謐湖光，聆聽自然樂章。」 5. 「小笠原山展望台」 at 「(4:00 PM)」 with a wooden observation deck above clouds at sunset illustration and description 「觀賞壯闊山景與雲海，欣賞日落。」 The right panel should depict a continuous glowing golden path winding through exactly 5 numbered map markers that match the left panel labels in order, with black-and-gold marker plaques reading: 1 「阿里山車站」, 2 「阿里山森林鐵路」, 3 「神木區棧道」, 4 「姊妹潭」, 5 「小笠原山展望台」. Show stop 1 as a rustic alpine wooden station perched on a cliff among pine forests; stop 2 as a small steam locomotive traveling on a curved mountain railway with smoke drifting upward; stop 3 as towering ancient red cypress trees with a spiral and zigzag wooden walkway around the trunks; stop 4 as an emerald lake surrounded by dense forest with a small pavilion and arched bridge; stop 5 as a lookout deck on a peak above a sea of clouds, facing a glowing sunset. The environment should feature layered mountain ranges, mist-filled valleys, evergreen forests, golden-hour light, luminous cloud seas, and a romantic painterly atmosphere with rich detail. At the bottom right, add a decorative compass rose labeled N, E, S, W, plus a dark green and gold information box with exactly 2 stats in traditional Chinese: 「總距離 ~9公里 / 5.6英里」 and 「預計時間 全天 - 14,500步」. Overall style: premium tourism poster, painterly digital illustration, nostalgic national-park brochure aesthetic, highly detailed, warm sepia and gold accents, elegant composition, readable Chinese text, vertical 2:3 poster.

title: 乡村车站女学生场景
content: A cinematic anime-style illustration of a quiet rural Japanese train station in early summer, filled with travel nostalgia and bright midday light. In the foreground, one high school girl stands alone on the platform near the left side of the frame, facing slightly toward the viewer with a shy, gentle posture, her legs together and one foot angled inward. She has {{hair_color}} short bobbed hair with soft bangs, and wears a classic Japanese sailor school uniform: a white long-sleeved sailor blouse with navy trim, a vivid red neckerchief, a dark navy pleated skirt, white socks, and dark brown loafers. She holds a dark school bag in one hand at her side. Her expression should feel calm, a little wistful, as if she was just about to speak before the train arrived. Place her beside an old weathered wooden station building with large windowpanes and a simple wooden bench. Above her is 1 hanging station sign reading {{station_name}}, with smaller romanized text “YAMANOSHITA” and small local line information beneath it. The right half of the image opens to 1 set of railway tracks receding into the distance, bordered by lush green grass and wildflowers, with 1 small local train approaching from far down the line. Add a few utility poles running alongside the tracks. In the deep background, show a dramatic mountain range with lingering snow on the peaks under a vivid blue sky with scattered white clouds. Composition should balance the girl on the left and the railway perspective on the right, with detailed background scenery, crisp sunlight, soft anime rendering, realistic textures in the station wood and rails, and a heartfelt slice-of-life travel mood.

title: 兽人偶像团体演唱会海报
content:
一张精致的动漫偶像演唱会主视觉图，场景设定在发光的舞台阶梯上，5 位兽人表演者以动态的对角线队形排列，置身于戏剧性的紫蓝色演唱会灯光和闪烁的聚光灯下。画面采用略微仰视的广角视角，以强调深度和舞台表现力，霓虹灯装饰的台阶向上延伸，背景由金属桁架结构勾勒。后方中央是一个巨大的发光徽章，几何星形标志内嵌爪印，两侧饰有月桂叶图案，暗示着偶像团体的标志。地板和台阶边缘闪烁着紫蓝色的轮廓光，空气中漂浮着细小的闪光颗粒和少量金色纸屑。整体氛围充满活力、胜利感和魅力，如同现场演出的宣传海报。

这 5 位表演者均为兽耳或兽人偶像角色，身着协调的奇幻舞台服装，配有腰带、链条、层叠面料、露指手套和定制配饰，每位成员拥有各自的主题色，同时共享统一的团体设计语言。从左至右依次为：一位身着深蓝色服装的灰狼少年，离镜头最近，自信地微笑并向观众伸出一只爪子；一位身着黑白橙色服装的橘色狐狸少年，带着俏皮的笑容向前迈步，一只手向前伸展；一位身着黑白绿色服装的灰白色狼少年，站在中心后方，指向斜上方；一位身着黑白粉色服装的白兔少女，拥有长长的兔耳、毛茸茸的尾巴、短裙层叠设计，一只手臂高举，摆出偶像姿势；以及一位身着海军蓝配金色服装的棕熊少年，以酷炫的回眸姿势站立，一只手臂向侧面伸展。所有角色均应具备生动的动漫面部表情、毛茸茸的皮毛渲染、细致的尾巴和爪子，以及高端精致的插画质量。

为每套服装赋予独特的强调色：左侧狼为蓝色，狐狸为橙色，中间狼为绿色，兔子为粉色，熊为金色。服装应融合偶像时尚与奇幻军事舞台风格：修身夹克或背心、不对称拼接、短裤或层叠短裙、束带、金属饰边、悬挂链条、装饰绳索及图案面料拼接。角色应看起来像一个名为 {{group_name}} 的统一偶像团体。使用 {{stage_lighting_color}} 作为主导灯光色调，辅以来自上方的明亮白色聚光灯和柔和的镜头光晕。在后方屏幕上放置 {{emblem_design}}。整体风格应为 {{art_style}}，氛围应呈现出 {{performance_mood}} 的感觉。

title: 城市巷弄壁画艺术家
content:
这是一个电影感、超写实的夜景，描绘了一位 {{artist}} 正在 {{setting}} 中绘制一幅大型 {{mural_subject}}。摄像机角度略低，营造出一种富有戏剧性和张力的视角。艺术家留着中等长度、略显凌乱的深色头发，留着淡淡的胡茬或短须，展现出一种粗犷而富有创造力的气质。

他身穿宽松的白色 T 恤和休闲牛仔裤，略显宽大的剪裁透着随性的街头风格。他站在墙边专注地进行喷漆创作，姿态投入。

他正在粗糙的砖墙上创作一幅巨大的超写实女性面孔壁画。壁画细节极其丰富——细腻的肤色、逼真的光影、传神的双眼和光泽感十足的双唇，看起来几乎如同照片一般。喷漆产生的细微雾气在空气中可见，捕捉着光线，增添了动感与氛围。

场景设定在夜晚狭窄的城市巷弄中，四周是高耸的建筑。环境粗粝且富有质感——陈旧的砖墙、飞溅的油漆、细微的污垢以及城市岁月的痕迹。霓虹灯牌和远处的路灯投射出青色、洋红色和蓝色的鲜艳倒影，营造出一种电影般、略带赛博朋克风格的氛围。

灯光设计富有戏剧性和层次感：冷色调的环境光充盈着巷弄，而暖色的霓虹灯高光则形成了鲜明对比。微妙的轮廓光勾勒出艺术家的剪影，使其从黑暗的背景中凸显出来。壁画被部分照亮，成为强有力的视觉焦点。

氛围包含轻微的雾气，增强了景深并使光线柔和地发光。整个场景令人沉浸，安静且充满艺术张力。

景深适中：艺术家和壁画处于清晰的焦点，而背景则渐变为柔和的虚化效果，并带有散景光斑。

风格：超写实、电影摄影、街头艺术美学、超精细纹理、高动态范围、细腻的胶片颗粒感。

相机参数：35mm 或 50mm 镜头，f/1.8–f/2.8 光圈，弱光摄影，轻微低角度拍摄，自然视角。

构图：竖构图（4:5 或 9:16），主体略微偏离中心，壁画占据画面主体，以实现强有力的视觉叙事。

content: 一张为 {{brand_name}} 设计的电影感街头美食广告海报，拍摄于雨后的城市街道夜晚，带有温暖的霓虹灯光虚化效果和戏剧性的美食摄影质感。构图为方形海报风格，黑色纹理背景上叠加了淡淡的重复文字，如 STEAM、SIZZLE、REPEAT 和 SPICE。左上角放置醒目的红白配色 {{logo_text}} 标志。画面中央是巨大的做旧粗体字 {{headline_text}}，采用高大的米白色字体。标题下方左侧是较小的堆叠文字 {{tagline_text}}。画面中总共展示 4 个 Momo：3 个完整的煎 Momo 在黑色平底锅上方飞舞，1 个切开的 Momo 位于顶部中央，露出纹理丰富的馅料。切开的 Momo 中喷涌出光泽诱人的红色辣椒酱，酱汁在空中飞溅，液滴凝固在周围。3 个完整的 Momo 呈金棕色，褶皱分明，表面有焦痕，裹着油和香料，动态地排列在锅上方，仿佛被热气和动作向上抛起。平底锅位于下方中央前景，锅内盛着滋滋作响的辣椒油、酱汁和散落的调料，一把金属锅铲从右侧伸入。在锅底位置加入火花、蒸汽、油滴和喷溅的酱汁，营造高能量的动态感。最底边缘处有火焰升腾。左下角前景展示一个印有相同标志的敞开外卖盒，里面装着 4 个白皙的蒸 Momo，旁边是一个黑色的小蘸料碗，盛着红酱。右侧背景中包含一个垂直发光的红色霓虹灯牌，写着 MOMO。左侧边缘添加一条细长的垂直红色文字条，写着 STREET HEAT • SPICY • FRESH。底部边缘包含页脚小字：STEAMED & PAN-FRIED MOMOS • SIGNATURE SPICE • {{edition_text}} 以及网址 wowmomo.com。风格：超写实商业美食摄影与动作海报设计相结合，对比强烈，带有火热的橙红色高光、深邃的黑色、湿润的倒影、清晰的纹理、浅景深、悬浮的动态、诱人的光泽，呈现高端快餐广告美学。

title: 恶搞奢侈品广告
content: 用于“{{product}}”麦芽饮料的高冲击力恶搞电商信息图。前景：特写镜头，一只粗糙、饱经风霜的手正将一罐色彩鲜艳的 {{product}} 高罐举向镜头。罐身微凉，带有可见的冷凝水珠，设计风格嘈杂且张扬。手和罐身带有轻微的微距镜头模糊效果以增加景深，但罐身作为主角产品依然清晰可见。中心主体：中景处，一个滑稽、衣衫不整的 {{subject}} 随意地坐在城市小巷的牛奶箱上。他留着邋遢的胡子，头发凌乱，穿着多层破旧的衣服，脸上挂着灿烂且无所谓的笑容。他看起来既混乱又有一种奇特的魅力，就像是“糟糕决定”的意外之王。他摆出自信的生活方式广告模特姿势，自豪地展示着手中的罐子。背景与灯光：极其精致的广告风格背景与肮脏的城市小巷环境相结合。远景处有柔焦的城市纹理、垃圾桶轮廓、涂鸦痕迹和零散的杂物。加入戏剧性的摄影棚灯光、柔和的光晕、彩虹棱镜光斑和微妙的漏光效果，使整体画面看起来比其主题内容高端得多。背景中可以艺术化地漂浮着几个模糊的 {{product}} 罐子，以增加荒诞感。排版与布局（粗体无衬线字体，白色与霓虹色点缀）：顶部中心（背景）：巨大的粗体文字“{{brand_name}}”位于主体后方。右上角：粗体文字“The Champagne of Bad Ideas”（糟糕主意的香槟）。中左： “Premium chaos and zero self-control”（高端混乱与零自控力）。中右：巨大的粗体“23”，配文“ounces of terrible decisions”（盎司的糟糕决定）。右下角：巨大的粗体“1”，配文“can to ruin tomorrow”（罐足以毁掉明天）。底部可选的小字说明：“Now with more regret”（现在，后悔加倍）。风格：超细节、8k 恶搞商业摄影，罐身焦点清晰，浅景深，充满活力的垃圾美学配色，简洁的广告构图，夸张的高端产品广告美学，精致品牌与破败主体之间的滑稽视觉对比。

title: 未来感动画行业杂志封面
content: 创作一张面向动画行业的未来感专业杂志封面，纵向构图，高端编辑设计，具有电影质感且精致。杂志刊头位于左上方，采用巨大的粗体白色无衬线字体，分两行排列：{{magazine_title}}。上方有一行黄色全大写标语：THE INDUSTRY TRADE MAGAZINE FOR ANIMATION PROFESSIONALS。刊头下方是一行较小的白色副标题：THE BUSINESS, TECHNOLOGY & ART OF ANIMATION。在右上角，放置堆叠的粗体期数信息：黄色的 VOL. 23 和白色的 SUMMER 2026。封面主体展示了一个风格化的女性类人机器人或数字模特，呈动态奔跑姿势，面向右侧，全身照，一条腿向后抬起，一只手臂伸展。她的身体是半透明的深色网格，内部关节、脊柱和肢体结构发出橙色光芒，并辅以蓝色和紫色的霓虹追踪线条，手腕、脚踝、臀部和脚部周围环绕着圆形运动光环。她留着凌乱的蓝色盘发，面部平滑简化，特征极少，如同 CG 角色原型。将她置于昏暗的动画工作室内部，背景中有模糊的显示器、办公桌和钉在墙上的概念艺术图，采用低调的情绪化环境光，使霓虹灯效果的人物成为视觉焦点。在脚下添加反光地板，双脚下方有绿色、黄色和橙色的同心全息环。在左侧，以整洁的杂志排版布置编辑封面标题。一个小小的黄色标签写着 COVER STORY。下方是一个巨大的粗体白色堆叠标题：{{cover_headline}}。标题下方是一个黄色副标题：HOW AI IS TRANSFORMING EVERY STAGE OF ANIMATION PRODUCTION。在左下角，列出 3 篇次要文章，每篇上方都有一条短黄色横线：1) INBETWEENING 2.0，配有白色小字导语：Inside the new generation of AI Inbetweening models changing the industry standard.，以及黄色的页码 p. 24。2) CONSISTENCY AT SCALE，配有白色小字导语：Maintaining character performance with AI-assisted interpolation.，以及黄色的页码 p. 38。3) ARTIST ORCHARD, NOT REPLACEMENT，配有白色小字导语：How top studios integrate AI tools while keeping artists in the loop.，以及黄色的页码 p. 52。在右下角附近，添加一个带有黄色轮廓的黑色圆形徽章，内含黄色和白色文字：顶部为 WORKFLOW SPOTLIGHT，中间为 DreamFrame Studios on building a proprietary AI animation stack，底部为黄色的 p. 60。在右下角，放置一个白色条形码框，上方标注价格：US $12.99 EUR €14.99，以及少量期数代码。配色方案采用黑色、炭灰色、白色、鲜黄色、电光橙、蓝色和紫色。整体感觉应高端、前瞻、精通技术且具有公信力，如同真实的 AI 驱动动画流水线行业杂志封面。

title: 荒诞小报黑豹新闻头版
content:
一张写实且略带幽默的报纸头版，从上方俯拍于木桌之上，设计呈现出印刷大报的质感，带有细腻的纸张纹理、折痕和轻微的镜头畸变。左上角的报头写着“The Daily Metro”，顶部中央的日期栏写着“2005 年 4 月 22 日，星期五”，右上角的版块标记为“CITY NEWS | 05”。左上方的红色横幅写着“EXCLUSIVE STORY”。醒目的超大黑色标题横跨多行：“动物园黑豹被抓包过双重生活——竟是酒吧里迷人的卡萨诺瓦！”下方的大副标题写着：“黑豹‘Marquise’夜间逃出动物园，流连酒吧，成为孤独女性心中的万人迷”。页面布局应模仿耸人听闻的小报风格，包含 1 个巨大的标题区、右上角 1 张大型主图、左侧正文下方 1 张小型插图、中央偏左 3 列密集的报纸正文、中间 1 个引语框、左下角 1 个带有黑豹肖像的次要新闻块、底部 3 张小型缩略图，以及右侧 1 个标题为“What’s Next For Mamquiss?”的侧边栏。大部分正文应保持微小且部分无意义或呈现 AI 生成的伪文字效果，但必须完整保留主要可见标题。

右上角的主图展示了一位身穿香槟色丝绸礼服的迷人金发女郎背影，她站在酒吧吧台旁，身边是一只直立在凳子上或前爪搭在吧台上的大型黑豹。酒吧背景中有许多酒瓶和玻璃器皿，灯光温暖。女子的面部被刻意用矩形模糊块遮挡。黑豹体态圆润、毛色光亮，渲染得十分逼真。左侧标题下方的插图展示了黑豹在夜间靠近动物园出口或路径指示牌的场景。左下角的肖像展示了黑豹面部的特写。底部的 3 张缩略图展示了夜生活场景：黑豹穿梭在酒吧内部、黑豹与两名女性坐在小圆桌旁、以及黑豹在昏暗暖光下休憩。

采用 21 世纪初的小报美学，使用高对比度的黑色标题字体、米白色新闻纸、红色强调线、窄栏排版以及略显杂乱的真实报纸构图。整体基调为冷面荒诞新闻风格，逼真到足以让人一眼误以为是真实报纸，页面填满大部分画面，并在自然室内光线下拍摄。

title: 哥特魔法女剑士

At the top inside the head area, place 1 grand stone city or castle complex glowing with pale golden light beneath turbulent clouds, and 3 dragons in the sky: 1 large dragon flying prominently on the upper right and 2 smaller distant dragons near the top edge. In the midsection, show 2 fur-cloaked heroic figures standing close together in a bleak winter atmosphere, one centered and one slightly left, with a looming iron-throne-like structure behind them. In the lower right interior, include 1 icy blue-eyed undead king emerging from darkness. Across the lower half, transition from cold mist and coastal water on the left into burning ruins and orange fire on the right, with 1 medium dragon flying near the center-lower area above the battlefield. Scatter tiny marching soldiers and riders along ridgelines and paths to imply war across the landscape. Use a muted palette of ash white, charcoal black, slate blue, steel gray, sepia, and ember orange, with cinematic high contrast, volumetric fog, painterly photo-collage realism, and intricate textured detail. Leave negative space around the silhouette on a warm off-white paper-like background. Add vertical Chinese slogan text along the upper left margin reading {{vertical_slogan}}. Add a small English logo area on the left reading {{series_logo}}. Place a large Chinese title near the lower left reading {{main_title}}, with the English subtitle "A SONG OF ICE AND FIRE" beneath it. Add small credit text below for the novel author George R. R. Martin. Along the bottom, display 5 house sigils in a horizontal row with bilingual labels: Stark, Lannister, Targaryen, Baratheon, Tarly. Beneath them, add the tagline {{bottom_tagline}}. Premium, moody, majestic, collectible poster design.

title: 动漫 X 平台对战海报
content:
Create a dramatic anime-style social media battle poster inspired by X/Twitter, split vertically down the center into two opposing halves with a glowing lightning-like divide and a huge luminous VS at the bottom center. The composition is a tall smartphone-optimized promotional key visual with dense layered UI cards, speech bubbles, tweet screenshots, reaction counters, and explosive energy effects. At the top center, place a large X logo with the title text "BATTLE" and the Japanese subtitle "Xでレスバ中". The left side is a cool purple and black theme, the right side is a hot red and white theme, with sparks, streaks, embers, and motion lines flying across both sides.

Show 2 anime schoolgirl characters facing off. On the left, a calm, composed girl representing logical rebuttal: long dark black-to-purple gradient hair, straight bangs, pale skin, slim build, black sailor-style school uniform with purple neck ribbon, pleated skirt, black knee socks, loafers, holding a smartphone in one hand and touching her glasses or temple with the other. Her face is intentionally obscured by a rectangular blur mosaic over the central face area. Her stance is reserved and still. Surround her with purple glowing tweet cards and speech bubbles. Her display name and handle should appear repeatedly as "雲居モヤ @kumoi_moya". Include exactly 3 large quoted statement boxes on her side with these Japanese texts: "それ、前提が雑だよね。", "感情だけでは通らないよ。", and "論点、そこじゃない。". Also include exactly 5 smaller purple UI/comment elements on her side: 1) a small comment bubble reading "それな 千代先輩、強すぎ…", 2) a small comment bubble reading "論理的で草 完全に正論パンチ", 3) a like card reading "いいね! 12.8K", 4) a repost card reading "リポスト 9,341", and 5) a dark trend card reading "おすすめトレンド #モヤVSエナ 42,857件のポスト". Add a central dark smartphone tweet panel tilted slightly, showing her tweet with profile icon, name, handle, the text "それ、前提が雑だよね。", and counters "312", "1,204", and "8,745".

On the right, show an aggressive, fiery girl representing emotional counterattack and confidence: vivid red hair in a high messy side bun with long loose hair, bright teal eyes, fair skin, energetic expression, open shouting mouth, pointing directly toward the opponent with one hand while the other hand rests on her hip. She wears a white blouse, black jumper-style dress or vest dress, oversized red bow tie, white loose socks scrunched around the ankles, and black loafers. Surround her with red glowing tweet cards and notification-style UI. Her display name and handle should appear repeatedly as "緋空エナ @hisora_ena". Include exactly 3 large quoted statement boxes on her side with these Japanese texts: "ちゃんと読んでから言ってる!?", "正論ぶってるだけでしょ!", and "逃げてないで答えて!". Also include exactly 6 smaller red UI/comment elements on her side: 1) a top notification badge card reading "通知 99+", 2) a small comment bubble reading "エナちゃん つよすぎるww", 3) a small comment bubble reading "言いたいこと全部言ってくれる!", 4) a like card reading "いいね! 18.7K", 5) a like card reading "いいね! 23.6K", and 6) a repost card reading "リポスト 11.2K". Add a red tweet panel near the center showing her tweet with profile icon, name, handle, the text "ちゃんと読んでから言ってる!?", and counters "278", "1,652", and "10.9K".

In the lower middle area, place exactly 3 central dark interface cards bridging both sides: 1) a quote-post card labeled "引用ポスト" showing both users and the exchange "論点、そこじゃない。" and "正論ぶってるだけでしょ!", 2) a reply count card reading "返信 1,876件", and 3) a bottom navigation bar styled like the X mobile app with home, search, notifications, messages icons and a blue button labeled "ポスト". The overall aesthetic should be glossy, high-contrast, highly rendered anime illustration with neon edge lighting, intense backlighting, dynamic perspective, layered translucency, and a chaotic viral-internet argument atmosphere. Use crisp Japanese UI typography, dramatic red-vs-purple color contrast, and polished promotional-poster quality.

title: 高端牛仔系列广告大片
content: 一张采用深沉、情绪化编辑风格拍摄的超写实高端牛仔广告。画面中，一名身着原色赤耳牛仔裤的男性正迈步向前，背景为近乎黑色的炭灰色，身体以 45 度角斜向面对镜头。牛仔裤呈现修身锥形剪裁，深靛蓝色水洗，大腿和膝盖处有细腻的磨白，加固的铜铆钉捕捉着环境光，干净的米白色撞色缝线占据了画面的下三分之二。构图采用浅景深，焦点清晰地落在牛仔布纹理上，上半身则呈现柔和的虚化。背景叠加了微妙的城市质感——电光黄和哑光橄榄色的模糊涂鸦笔触，在厚重的暗角中隐约可见。多行超小号全大写排版文字以不同角度环绕在人物周围，内容包括“{{slogan_one}}”和“{argument name="slogan two" default="WEAR WHAT YOU'VE BEEN THROUGH"}”——部分文字垂直排列，部分呈 30 度角，营造出一种混乱而刻意的图形杂志风格。右上角，醒目的品牌标识以纯白色呈现在深色背景上。顶部中央，一条纤细的水平导航式文字栏显示着“AUTHENTIC FIT · LIVED-IN LUXURY · BUILT TO LAST”，采用间距宽阔的全大写衬线字体。右侧中央放置了一个醒目的大标题——“{{main_headline}}”，采用超粗白色大号字体，下方紧跟较细字重的“THE MOMENT”，营造出强烈的视觉层级感。小巧的黄色加号（+）符号和对角箭头（↗）作为装饰细节散布在画面各处。左下角是醒目的口号组合：“DEFINE YOUR DENIM”，采用大号粗体无衬线白色文字，下方配有一行细小的副标题：“An unapologetic reminder that style is a statement. Every crease tells a story.”（风格即宣言，无需辩解。每一道褶皱都在诉说故事。）整体光影极具戏剧性和方向感——左侧的一束冷色主光使铜铆钉闪烁，深靛蓝牛仔布在黑暗中散发出微妙的光泽。膝盖磨白处可见清晰的织物纹理宏观细节。照片级真实感。商业摄影品质。高对比度。4K 分辨率。专为社交媒体优化的 3:4 竖屏格式。
